Meituan runs a partner/developer cooperation center exposing merchant, delivery/logistics, and local-services integration APIs to business partners; these are partner-gated and documented in Chinese, with no public OpenAPI specification, SDK registry, or self-serve developer signup surfaced at this time.

providers.name: Joes Future Food (Zhouzi Future)
providers.description: Joes Future Food (周子未来 / Nanjing Zhouzi Future Food Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Nanjing-based cellular agriculture and food-technology company pioneering cultivated (cell-cultured) meat in China. The founding team produced what it describes as China's first piece of cultivated meat, and the company develops cell-cultured pork products (pork belly, fatback, skin, meatballs, and a mixed family pack) alongside serum-free culture media and a catalog of primary and gene-edited animal cell lines (porcine adipose and muscle stem cells, bovine muscle and adipose cells, chicken embryo fibroblasts, and more) used across cultivated-meat research and biomanufacturing. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company runs a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Alpha Biopharma
providers.description: Alpha Biopharma is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Shanghai, China, with an additional office in Beijing. The company focuses on the clinical development and commercialization of global innovative drugs across oncology and immunotherapy, spanning medical affairs, clinical operations, regulatory affairs and commercialization. Its lead product is Zorifertinib (formerly AZD-3759, marketed as Zorifer), a next-generation EGFR TKI designed for EGFR mutation positive advanced NSCLC patients with central nervous system metastases, which received NMPA approval in November 2024 as the first EGFR-TKI indicated for lung cancer with brain metastases. Alpha Biopharma also partners with Wugen Inc. on universal off-the-shelf memory NK and CAR-T cell therapies. The company raised a Series A led by Qiming Venture Partners. Alpha Biopharma publishes a corporate marketing website only and operates no public API, developer portal, or software platform.

providers.name: LemonBox
providers.description: LemonBox (来檬) is a health-technology brand working in AI-generative personalized nutrition. Founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley, incubated at the University of Chicago Polsky Center in 2017, and accepted into Y Combinator in 2018, it entered the Chinese market that year and is now headquartered in Shanghai. LemonBox builds individualized daily vitamin and supplement packs from a three-minute FFQ (food frequency questionnaire) nutrition assessment scored by its LemonAlgo adaptive engine, then fulfills them one pack at a time (MOQ=1) through its Personalization Fulfillment Center in Hong Kong. The company reports serving more than 10 million cumulative users as of 2026 and sells both direct-to-consumer and B2B. Investors include Y Combinator and Partech. LemonBox operates a consumer web and WeChat mini-program experience and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; its agent-facing surface is limited to a published /llms.txt and a robots.txt that explicitly allow-lists generative-AI crawlers.

providers.name: Beike
providers.description: Beike (KE Holdings Inc.) is China's largest integrated online-and-offline platform for housing transactions and services, connecting home buyers, sellers, renters, and real estate agents. It operates the Beike (贝壳) platform and the Lianjia (链家) brokerage brand, along with businesses spanning existing-home and new-home transactions, home rentals, and home renovation and furnishing. Its Agent Cooperation Network (ACN) lets brokerages and agents share listings and commissions across a standardized workflow. KE Holdings is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BEKE) and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2423) and is headquartered in Beijing. This API Evangelist profile was created from venture-portfolio sourcing and enriched via the pipeline; Beike operates consumer-facing housing web and mobile properties and does not currently publish a public developer API program.

providers.name: Bitauto
providers.description: Bitauto (易车, Yiche) is one of China's largest automotive internet companies, founded in 2000 with the mission of making car ownership simpler. It operates consumer-facing platforms that provide car buyers with pricing, reviews, specifications, and automotive news across new and used vehicles, alongside an enterprise EP (dealer) platform offering web-based digital marketing and CRM applications to Chinese automobile dealers. Bitauto runs regional informational portals across 20+ countries cataloging Chinese car brands. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures; as of enrichment Bitauto publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: ZhongAn Insurance
providers.description: ZhongAn Online P&C Insurance Co., Ltd. is China's first online-only insurance company, founded in 2013 by Ant Financial, Tencent, and Ping An and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (6060) in 2017. Headquartered in Shanghai, ZhongAn sells digital insurance across health, consumer finance, auto, and lifestyle lines entirely through internet channels, and operates a partner "open platform" (open.zhongan.com) plus a technology arm, ZhongAn Technology (zhongan.io), that offers insurtech and cloud services. ZhongAn does not publish a self-serve public developer API program or OpenAPI documentation; integration is partner/ecosystem-driven. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of softbank-vision-fund and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: 21Vianet
providers.description: 21Vianet (VNET Group, Inc.) is the largest carrier-neutral internet and data center services provider in China, operating more than 50 data centers across over 20 cities with tens of thousands of cabinets and multi-terabit network port capacity. The company delivers hosting, managed hosting, interconnectivity, cloud, and hybrid IT infrastructure services to enterprise customers, and is the exclusive operator of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, and Power Platform in mainland China through its Blue Cloud subsidiary. 21Vianet trades on Nasdaq under the ticker VNET. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead; 21Vianet does not publish a public first-party developer API program, so most API artifacts are legitimately not applicable.

providers.name: 51Talk Koala (koalareading.com)
providers.description: koalareading.com serves 51Talk考拉外教官网, the marketing landing page for 51Talk's "Koala" online English foreign-teacher tutoring product aimed at Chinese K-12 learners. The site is a single-page property (hero banner plus footer) operated by 大生在线（深圳）文化传媒科技有限公司 of Shenzhen under ICP filing 粤ICP备2023085692号, with lizhen01@51talk.com published as the technical support contact. The profile entered the API Evangelist network as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio lead under the name "koalareading" (考拉阅读 / Koala Reading, a Chinese K-12 reading-comprehension edtech); the domain as observed on 2026-07-19 serves the 51Talk Koala product instead, and the relationship between the two is not asserted here. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, documentation, SDK, CLI, or machine-readable discovery surface, so this profile carries only probed evidence.

providers.name: Chiral Quest
providers.description: Chiral Quest (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. (凯瑞斯德生化（苏州）有限公司) is a Chinese pharmaceutical CDMO specializing in chiral chemistry. The company operates asymmetric catalytic hydrogenation, enzyme-catalyzed biosynthesis, flow chemistry, and process innovation technology platforms, using proprietary catalysts to develop and manufacture chiral drug molecules, key raw materials, regulatory starting materials (RSMs), and advanced GMP intermediates for global pharmaceutical companies. Founded around its asymmetric hydrogenation catalyst technology, Chiral Quest merged with Jiangxi Longlai in 2012 and with Suzhou Pengxu in 2020; the group employs more than 800 people including a research team of roughly 150. Suzhou is the parent company and R&D center, Jiangxi Longlai is the manufacturing base, and the company maintains offices in the United Kingdom and the United States. Chiral Quest is a brochure-site company with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable data surface.

providers.name: liangyihui
providers.description: liangyihui is a company operating the web property at liangyihui.net, surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program: no developer portal, no API reference or documentation, no OpenAPI, AsyncAPI or GraphQL definition, no first-party SDK packages on any public registry, and no working /.well-known/ discovery surface. The public site is served from Chinese CDN infrastructure (Tengine / kunlunpi) behind a bot shield that answers every path with the same obfuscated JavaScript challenge, so the property soft-404s and cannot be crawled or inspected. A live API host does exist at api.liangyihui.net: it answers its root with a Tomcat-served "Welcome to LYH!" page and returns genuine HTTP 404s for probe paths, indicating a real but private first-party backend for the company's own clients rather than a documented public API. This profile records verified DNS, TLS and endpoint posture only; no API artifacts have been fabricated.

providers.name: Light Chaser Animation Studios
providers.description: Light Chaser Animation Studios (追光动画) is a Chinese computer-animation film studio founded in March 2013 by Gary Wang (王微), founder and former CEO of the video platform Tudou, and headquartered in Beijing. The studio produces original CG animated feature films for the Chinese domestic market, drawing on Chinese mythology, literature and history. Its released titles include Little Door Gods (小门神), Tea Pets (阿唐奇遇), Cats and Peachtopia (猫与桃花源), White Snake (白蛇：缘起), New Gods: Nezha Reborn (新神榜：哪吒重生), White Snake 2: Green Snake (白蛇2：青蛇劫起), New Gods: Yang Jian (新神榜：杨戬) and Chang An (长安三万里). Light Chaser is a film-production company rather than a technology vendor: its public web presence is a bilingual WordPress marketing and recruiting site at zhuiguang.com, and as of this enrichment pass it publishes no developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API artifacts of any kind.

providers.name: Vistel
providers.description: Vistel (Beijing Zhiyuan Huitu Technology, 致远慧图) is a Beijing-based medical AI company founded in 2016 that applies computer vision and deep learning to ophthalmology. Its NMPA Class III and EU CE certified software analyzes fundus images to screen for diabetic retinopathy, glaucoma, and age-related macular degeneration, paired with its RC350 and RX350 fundus cameras and VS550 vision screener, plus telemedicine and image management systems. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Cyberport Hong Kong, and Redhill Capital. Vistel publishes no public developer portal or API surface.

providers.name: Wuxi Vision Pro
providers.description: Wuxi Vision Pro Co., Ltd. (无锡蕾明视康科技有限公司, "蕾明视康"), founded in 2010, is a Chinese ophthalmic medical device company that develops, manufactures, and sells intraocular lenses (IOLs) and other high-end ophthalmic consumables, focused on foldable IOL R&D and domestic substitution of imported lenses. Headquartered in Wuxi with a Shanghai branch, and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. No public API or developer surface was found.

providers.name: Avistone
providers.description: Beijing Avistone Biotechnology Co., Ltd. is a commercial-stage innovative biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Beijing, China, focused on the research, development, and commercialization of first-in-class and best-in-class oncology therapies. Founded in 2012 (originally Beijing Pearl Biotechnology) and renamed Avistone in 2018, the company has two approved cancer drugs on the market: Vebreltinib (万比锐®), a MET inhibitor approved for non-small cell lung cancer and glioma indications and included in China's National Reimbursement Drug List, and Andamertinib (安比锐®), an EGFR exon 20 insertion inhibitor approved in 2026 for advanced NSCLC. Avistone maintains a pipeline of additional candidates (ANS01 through ANS09) across solid-tumor indications and is backed by IDG Capital. The company publishes no public developer API or programmatic surface; this profile captures its corporate and investor identity.

providers.name: 58.com
providers.description: 58.com (58同城, "58 Tongcheng") is China's largest online classifieds and local-services marketplace, often called the "Chinese Craigslist." Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing, it operates listings across recruitment and jobs, real estate and housing (Anjuke), used goods (Zhuanzhuan), automobiles, local services, and yellow-pages business directories. Formerly listed on the NYSE (WUBA), it was taken private in 2020 by a Warburg Pincus / General Atlantic consortium. Its 58 Open Platform (open.58.com) exposes payment, recruitment/jobs data, housing, local-service information, security risk-control, marketing, and social capabilities to approved third-party partners via reviewed developer accounts and API keys. Backed historically by DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Dada
providers.description: Dada Group (Dada Nexus, NASDAQ: DADA) is a leading Chinese instant retail and local on-demand delivery platform, headquartered in Shanghai and founded in 2014. It operates an open, crowdsourced delivery network of more than one million rider partners serving supermarkets, pharmacies, fresh-food and restaurant merchants across thousands of counties and cities, alongside merchant fulfillment products such as the Haibo in-store logistics system and the Dada Youjian picking service. Now integrated into the JD.com ecosystem, its core delivery brand was rebranded to JD Instant Delivery (京东秒送) in May 2024. Dada runs a merchant Open Platform (开放平台) for order, delivery-tracking and fulfillment integrations. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: igetget
providers.description: igetget is the English name for 得到 (Dedao), a Chinese knowledge-service and lifelong-learning platform operated by Beijing Siwei Zaowu Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京思维造物信息科技股份有限公司), the company behind Luojisiwei (罗辑思维) founded by Luo Zhenyu. The app sells curated courses, expert lectures, ebooks, and audiobooks across finance, economics, law, management, psychology, and self-improvement, alongside an enterprise edition, a web edition, and the annual "Time's Friend" (时间的朋友) New Year's Eve lecture. It is a consumer content product; enrichment found no public API specification or developer documentation, only an open-platform (开放平台) login surface at open.igetget.com. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: JD Business
providers.description: JD Business is the enterprise-facing arm of JD.com (Jingdong), one of China's largest technology and retail companies, offering B2B procurement, supply-chain, and corporate purchasing services to businesses. JD.com operates across retail, logistics, technology, health, and industrials, and runs the JD Open Platform (JOS / "Zeus" Developer Center) at jos.jd.com, where third-party merchants and partners integrate with JD's e-commerce, order, product, and logistics systems. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-linked company and is being enriched from JD's public surface; JD's developer platform and enterprise services are primarily China-market and Chinese-language.

providers.name: RedNote (Xiaohongshu)
providers.description: RedNote, known in China as Xiaohongshu (小红书, "Little Red Book"), is a Shanghai-based social and e-commerce platform operated by Xingyin Information Technology (行吟信息科技). It blends user-generated lifestyle content, community discovery, and in-app shopping, and is one of China's largest content-commerce platforms. Beyond the consumer app, RedNote runs an open platform (open.xiaohongshu.com) plus the Qianfan (千帆) merchant commerce workbench (ark.xiaohongshu.com) and a mini-program surface (miniapp.xiaohongshu.com) that let brands, merchants, and marketing partners integrate storefronts, content, and campaigns. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of HongShan (Sequoia China) and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Bondent (博恩登特)
providers.description: Bondent (博恩登特, Bondent Group / 博恩集团) is a Chinese oral-healthcare technology company that provides an integrated, digitalized platform and hardware for dental clinics. It develops and manufactures its own clinical equipment — oral CBCT / CT imaging (Bojue series), dental microscopes (Semorr), dental chairs (Bomesin), dental lasers (Doctor Smile), UDG endodontic/root-canal systems, intraoral digital impression scanners, and periodontal/implant and digital-orthodontics solutions — alongside the Edent clinic-management software and the "Bondent Cloud" (博恩云) app for dentists. The company pairs manufacturing with training academies (Bondent Academy / 博恩学苑, Star EMBA), operating eight factories, four solution families across ten product series, over a thousand employees, and serving more than 200,000 dentists. This API Evangelist profile was seeded as a qiming portfolio lead; no public developer or API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Cure Genetics
providers.description: Cure Genetics (克睿基因) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company founded in 2016 and based in Suzhou, Jiangsu, China, developing cell and gene therapies for solid tumors and genetic diseases. Its differentiated pipeline is built on two proprietary platforms: AIMS CAR-NKT, a cell-therapy approach engineered to improve solid-tumor infiltration and modulate the tumor microenvironment, and VELP, an AAV (adeno-associated viral) vector technology targeting the nervous system, heart, and kidneys. Lead programs include CGC729, an anti-CD70 CAR-NKT therapy in Phase I trials for renal cell carcinoma, and CGC-602, a PD-1-IL-2v bispecific molecule for cancer immunotherapy. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Advantech Capital, and Oriza Holdings. It publishes no public API, developer platform, or technical documentation; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record surfaced from the Qiming portfolio.

providers.name: Inscinstech
providers.description: Inscinstech (Suzhou Inscinstech Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese life-sciences instrumentation manufacturer serving the biopharmaceutical industry. It designs and builds equipment for oligonucleotide and nucleic-acid synthesis, chromatography and protein purification, tangential-flow filtration, bioreactors and cell culture, nanomedicine (LNP) preparation, high-pressure preparative liquid chromatography, peptide synthesis, and analytical instruments (HPLC, capillary electrophoresis, pumps and valves), spanning laboratory, pilot, and production scale. It also delivers end-to-end process solutions for oligonucleotide drugs, mRNA, peptides, and recombinant proteins. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It is a hardware and instruments provider and publishes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology)
providers.description: Shinehe (Hangzhou Xinzeyuan Medical Technology Co., Ltd. / 杭州鑫泽源医疗科技有限公司) is a Hangzhou, China based contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) for the minimally invasive medical device sector. Founded in 2015, the company provides precision component manufacturing, customized development, and OEM/ODM services covering endoscope accessories (insertion, operation, and light guide components), single-use consumables (hemostasis, biopsy, EMR, dilation), rigid endoscope components, and minimally invasive surgical instruments, aiming to be a global minimally invasive medical device supply-chain platform. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public API, developer portal, or SDK surface was found during enrichment; this profile is maintained as a company identity record.

providers.name: Busy Ming Group
providers.description: Busy Ming Group (Hunan Mingming Busy Commercial Chain Co., Ltd. / 湖南鸣鸣很忙商业连锁股份有限公司) is a mass-market snack retail chain operator headquartered in Changsha, Hunan, China, and a consumer-sector portfolio company of HongShan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). It operates two discount snack store brands — Snacks Are Busy (零食很忙, founded 2017) and Zhao Yiming Snacks (赵一鸣零食, founded 2019) — which combined into a network of more than 21,000 retail locations, heavily concentrated in county-level cities and townships. The group publishes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, franchising, and investor-relations web presence.

providers.name: InventisBio
providers.description: InventisBio Co., Ltd. (Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market: 688382) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company headquartered in the Pudong New Area of Shanghai, China, with operations in New Jersey, United States. Built on independent R&D capabilities, InventisBio discovers and develops innovative small-molecule and targeted therapies for oncology, autoimmune, and metabolic diseases to address unmet medical needs. The company has advanced multiple drug candidates into clinical trials, including late-stage Phase III programs in non-small cell lung cancer and breast cancer, alongside earlier-stage assets targeting KRAS G12C, synthetic-lethal pathways, hyperuricemia/gout, and plaque psoriasis. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. InventisBio is a research-driven pharmaceutical company and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: venusmedtech
providers.description: Venus Medtech (Hangzhou) Inc. is a China-based innovator in transcatheter structural heart valve therapies, founded in 2009 and headquartered in Hangzhou. Listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (2500.HK), it pioneered first-in-China TAVR and TPVR solutions and covers TAVR, TPVR, TMVR and TTVR heart valve intervention devices, including the commercialized VenusA-Valve, VenusA-Plus, VenusA-Pro, VenusA-Deluxe and the VenusP-Valve TPVR system. It is a physical medical-device manufacturer that publishes a corporate/product marketing site and an eIFU (electronic Instructions for Use) portal, and has no public developer API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment.

providers.name: cutt
providers.description: cutt (cutt.com) is a Chinese technology company surfaced from the published portfolio of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of the 2026-07-20 enrichment pass the company has no reachable public web presence: the cutt.com apex does not complete an HTTPS connection, www.cutt.com returns HTTP 404 for the site root and every probed path, and no developer, documentation, or API subdomain (api./developer./docs./ dev./open.) resolves. One surviving subdomain, zhiyue.cutt.com, issues a 301 redirect to api.zhiyueapp.cn — a live JSON API host fronted by an APISIX 3.4.1 gateway that returns an empty 200 body and publishes no documentation. The zhiyueapp.cn domain is registered to 北京简网生活圈科技有限公司 (Beijing Jianwang Life Circle Technology Co., Ltd.), which appears to be the operating entity behind the cutt.com property. The cutt.com domain itself was created in 2003 and remains registered through Alibaba Cloud Computing Ltd. (HiChina) with an April 2027 expiry, so the registration is maintained even though the public site is not being served. No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, SDK, portal, changelog, status page, or /.well-known/ discovery document could be found on any reachable host. This profile therefore records probed infrastructure evidence only; it carries no fabricated API surface and should be revisited if the company restores a public developer presence.

providers.name: docin
providers.description: docin (豆丁网, docin.com) is a Chinese C2C document-sharing platform operated by Beijing Docin Century Network Technology (北京豆丁世纪网络技术有限公司) that faces the global market. The platform hosts over 1.3 billion documents, books, magazines, and publications spanning education, architecture and construction, business and contracts, medical and psychological materials, industry reports, and legal documents, supporting both learning and practical application. It offers a "豆丁书房" (Docin Reading Room) mobile reading app and VIP membership tiers. docin was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Probing found no public developer or API platform: open.docin.com 301-redirects to the homepage, /app/api returns 404, and no /.well-known discovery documents are published.

providers.name: Kuwo Music
providers.description: Kuwo Music (酷我音乐) is a Chinese online music streaming service, founded in Beijing in 2005, that grew from a desktop music player into one of China's major consumer streaming apps across desktop, web, and mobile. Kuwo merged with Kugou under China Music Corporation, which was subsequently acquired by Tencent Music Entertainment Group, and Kuwo now operates as one of TME's music apps alongside QQ Music and Kugou. Kuwo entered the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead via Qiming. It is a consumer-facing streaming property rather than an API-first provider, and no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface has been verified for it.

providers.name: Pinduoduo
providers.description: Pinduoduo is a China-focused social commerce and agriculture-first e-commerce marketplace operated by PDD Holdings (Nasdaq: PDD), the multinational commerce group that also runs the cross-border marketplace Temu. Pinduoduo pioneered the "team purchase" (group-buy) model, connecting hundreds of millions of consumers directly with farmers, manufacturers, and merchants at scale. For developers, Pinduoduo runs a merchant-facing Open Platform (open.pinduoduo.com) that exposes gateway-style APIs for goods, orders, logistics, promotions, and store management to ISVs and merchant tools; that platform is geo-restricted to mainland China and was not directly reachable for artifact capture in this pass. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China) and enriched with verifiable corporate identity and domain security posture.

providers.name: Pony.ai
providers.description: Pony.ai is a global autonomous-mobility company founded in Silicon Valley in 2016 and dual-headquartered in Guangzhou and Fremont. Its core technology is the Pony "virtual driver", a Level 4 autonomous driving stack deployed across three business lines: Robotaxi (PonyPilot+ ride-hailing service operating in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen, plus pilots in California and Arizona), Robotruck (autonomous heavy-duty trucking in China), and Personally Owned Vehicle (POV) intelligent driving software for production passenger cars. The company is publicly listed on NASDAQ under PONY and reports more than 32 million kilometres of autonomous road testing. Pony.ai does not publish a traditional public developer API; its public GitHub presence includes infrastructure tooling such as pony_aim (experiment tracker) and bazel-buildfarm rather than the AV stack itself. This profile captures the company surface and any developer-relevant artifacts.

providers.name: FIMI Technology
providers.description: FIMI Technology Ltd. (Beijing FIMI Technology Co., Ltd. / Shenzhen FIMI Robot Technology Co., Ltd.) is a consumer aerial-imaging hardware manufacturer founded in May 2014 as a member of the Xiaomi ecosystem. FIMI designs and sells affordable camera drones, handheld gimbal cameras, and smartphone gimbals, with a product lineup that includes the X8 series (X8 SE, X8 Pro, X8 Tele, X8T enterprise), the compact Mini 3, the Manta VTOL fixed-wing drone, and the PALM series gimbal cameras. The company holds hundreds of patents across flight control, wireless transmission links, mechatronic design, gimbal image-stabilization, and computer vision. FIMI is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This is a consumer-electronics company with no public developer program, API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: forgame
providers.description: Forgame Holdings Limited (HKEX 00484) is a Hong Kong-listed technology holding company founded in 2009 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China. It operates across cloud/light gaming, fintech, electronic trade, and cloud storage. Its web and mobile game publishing platform 91wan, run by PRC entity Guangzhou Weidong Internet Technology Co., Ltd., has distributed over 100 web games and attracted more than 200 million registered players. In 2016 the group obtained an internet micro-lending (fintech) license in the PRC, and since 2019 has explored e-sports and virtual-reality games. Forgame is tracked by API Evangelist as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners; no public developer API or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Kintep (Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.)
providers.description: Jiangsu Kintep Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. (江苏康泰环保股份有限公司), founded in 2011 and headquartered in Taizhou, Jiangsu, China, is a national high-tech enterprise that designs, manufactures, sells, and services new-type environmental-protection equipment and complete turnkey solutions. Kintep focuses on solid-liquid separation and intelligent sludge / pollutant collection and treatment. Its KINTEP product line includes multi-disc (stacked-screw) sludge dewatering machines, integrated automatic chemical dosing units, dense-phase belt sludge deep-dewatering machines, high-efficiency fully-automatic filter-press systems, Lamella sedimentation tanks, and screw presses. The company operates seven national customer-service centers (Shenzhen, Wuhan, Chongqing, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shanghai, Yixing) and exports to customers worldwide. Kintep is a physical industrial-equipment manufacturer and does not publish a public web API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: 1yongcloud
providers.description: Beijing Yiyong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京壹永科技有限公司 / 1yongcloud), founded in October 2017, is a Chinese oncology big-data and artificial-intelligence company. It builds medical-data collection, quality-control and governance capabilities and healthcare information products for hospitals and government health programs. Its product lines include a tumor diagnosis-and-treatment standardization and cost-rationalization platform, a hospital cancer opportunistic-screening platform, an integrated clinical-research platform, and a smart-hospital comprehensive operations decision platform. The company is backed by investors including Qiming Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital China, and Cathay Capital. It operates no public developer portal, API, or SDK; this profile tracks 1yongcloud as a company in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ark Biopharmaceutical
providers.description: Ark Biopharmaceutical (爱科百发, Ark Biosciences) is a Shanghai-based clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of innovative therapies for respiratory diseases and pediatric conditions. Its pipeline includes AK0529 (ziresovir) for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection, AK0901 for ADHD, AK3280 for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, AK0610 for RSV prevention, and AK0705 for COPD. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As a drug-development company it publishes a corporate website, R&D pipeline, and news center, but exposes no public developer platform, API, or technical integration surface at this time.

providers.name: Beijing Goodwill (bjgoodwill)
providers.description: Beijing Goodwill Information Technology Co., Ltd. (北京嘉和美康信息技术有限公司, brand 嘉和美康 / Goodwill E-Health) is a Chinese healthcare-IT company founded in 2005 and publicly listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market (科创板, code 688246). It builds electronic medical record (EMR) systems, hospital information platforms, clinical data centers, smart-healthcare products, internet-medicine platforms, and medical research / big-data solutions used across hospitals and clinics in more than thirty provinces and autonomous regions of China. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer portal, API, or OpenAPI surface was found during enrichment; this profile is identity-only.

providers.name: Insight Lifetech
providers.description: Insight Lifetech (Shenzhen North Star Cardiovascular Medical Technology, 北芯生命科技) is a Chinese medical-technology company developing innovative solutions for the precision diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. Its portfolio spans coronary physiology and intravascular imaging (FFR, IVUS) and cardiac electrophysiology, including its InsightPFA pulsed-field ablation platform. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market (688712) in February 2026. This is a medical-device manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network for company intelligence.

providers.name: Singular Medical
providers.description: Singular Medical (Suzhou Singular Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. / 苏州无双医疗设备有限公司) is a Chinese medical-device company pioneering the domestic research, development, and manufacturing of cardiac rhythm management (CRM) products. It builds China's own implantable cardioverter defibrillators (ICD) and implantable cardiac monitors (ICM) — devices that automatically identify malignant arrhythmias, deliver anti-tachycardia pacing and defibrillation to prevent sudden cardiac death, and provide long-term subcutaneous ECG monitoring for the diagnosis of unexplained syncope, atrial fibrillation, and cryptogenic stroke, with cloud-based event transmission for remote clinical review. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners. This is a medical-device hardware manufacturer with a corporate marketing web presence and no public developer, API, or documentation program at this time.

providers.name: Xiaomishu (订餐小秘书)
providers.description: Xiaomishu (订餐小秘书, "Dining Little Secretary") is a Shanghai-based restaurant reservation and dining-marketing technology company operating since 2005 via xiaomishu.com and the 021-57575777 booking hotline. Its platforms — 订餐小秘书, 宴位 (Yanwei, an AI-driven dynamic-pricing product for restaurant private rooms), and 高能店长 — let diners book tables and discounted private-room packages at Shanghai restaurants through web, WAP (m.xiaomishu.com / m.57.cn), phone, and WeChat mini-program channels. The company cites strategic investment from Ctrip and SIG and was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a Qiming Venture Partners portfolio lead. It publishes no public developer API, portal, or machine-readable surface; api.xiaomishu.com serves a closed (HTTP 403) backend, and the main site is HTTP-only with a mismatched HTTPS certificate.

providers.name: LeapStack
providers.description: LeapStack (栈略数据 / Stack Strategy Data) is a Shanghai-based insurance technology and data-analytics company operating in China's health-insurance sector, applying big-data and risk-control intelligence to help insurers with claims, underwriting, and healthcare-cost analysis. It is a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence (www.leapstack.tech) is a client-rendered marketing site; as of this enrichment pass no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or other public API surface was found. This profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company record.

providers.name: Yuanbao (元保)
providers.description: Yuanbao Inc. (元保) is a technology-driven online insurance distribution platform in China, founded in 2019 and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker YB. It distributes medical, critical illness, accident, property, and pet insurance products directly to consumers and provides system services to partnered insurance carriers, embedding proprietary large language models into core functions including risk identification, customer acquisition, product design, personalized recommendation, policy management, and claims processing. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, Yuanbao operates a consumer-facing web and mobile experience (yuanbaobaoxian.com, redirecting to yuanbaobaoxian.cn) and does not publish a public developer portal, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or open API platform at this time.

providers.name: yuanxinjituan
providers.description: Yuanxinjituan (Beijing Yuanxin Technology Group Co., Ltd. / 圆心科技集团) is a Chinese healthcare-technology company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing, dedicated to delivering value across the full patient care cycle. It operates an integrated online-and-offline platform spanning three core scenarios — medical consultation, medication, and payment — connecting doctors, patients, pharmaceutical companies, and insurers. Its businesses include the Miaoshou (妙手) internet hospital, hospital-side and DTP pharmacies (圆心药房), a prescription-sharing platform, pharmaceutical distribution, and the Yuanxin health-insurance arm (圆心惠保). Backed by Tencent, Sequoia China, and Qiming Venture Partners, Yuanxin is one of China's largest full-chain service providers for the commercialization of innovative drugs and has pursued a Hong Kong Stock Exchange main-board listing. The company presents a consumer/enterprise healthcare surface; no public developer API, open platform, or documentation was found during enrichment.

providers.name: aistarfish
providers.description: aistarfish (aistarfish.com) is the web home of Haixin Health (海心健康), a Chinese digital-health company operated by Zhejiang Haixin Zhihui Technology Co., Ltd. that provides full-course disease management and support services for cancer patients across their entire treatment journey. Its consumer-facing products are iOS and Android mobile apps built around a patient community, peer-support networks, patient and official medical diaries, and patient-to-doctor connections, under the mission of "helping cancer patients live longer and live better." The company holds an Internet Pharmaceutical Information Service qualification. It is surfaced here as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network. As of this pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Arrail Group
providers.description: Arrail Group (瑞尔集团) is one of the largest privately owned dental service providers in China, operating premium Arrail Dental clinics and the Rytime Dental (瑞泰口腔) network across major Chinese cities. The company delivers general dentistry, orthodontics, implants, and pediatric dental care through directly operated clinics and hospitals. It is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and counts Qiming Venture Partners among its investors. Arrail Group was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio company; it is a consumer healthcare provider and publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: besunyen
providers.description: Besunyen is a Chinese consumer-health company known for herbal weight-management, functional and detox teas plus related wellness and nutrition products, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. Enrichment on 2026-07-18 found no public developer, API, or documentation surface — besunyen.com serves only an nginx 404 and its TLS certificate is issued for besunyen.co (hostname mismatch); the only real artifact captured is a domain-security probe.

providers.name: Boohee
providers.description: Boohee (薄荷健康) is a Chinese consumer health-technology company focused on scientific weight management, serving a cumulative 180 million users over its ~17-year history. Its portfolio spans the Boohee Health mobile app (calorie and food tracking, diet and exercise logging, AI weight-management coaching, meal plans, smart body scales, community), Boohee Life nutritional foods and subscription services, the Boohee Life Internet Hospital (Tianjin-based telemedicine for internal and traditional Chinese medicine), and a Boohee weight-loss SaaS platform that helps hospitals stand up weight-management clinics. The company operates as a consumer mobile and content platform and does not publish a public developer API or open platform; this profile is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead of DCM Ventures.

providers.name: Brosmed
providers.description: BrosMed Medical (Guangdong Brosmed Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2012 and headquartered in Dongguan, Guangdong, China, specializing in the research, manufacturing, and global sale of high-performance vascular intervention medical devices. Its product families span cardiovascular intervention, peripheral vascular intervention, hemodialysis access, neurointervention, and intervention accessories. The company employs over 1,000 staff, holds 650+ product registrations, and sells across 100+ countries. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a physical medical-device manufacturer it publishes no public developer/API surface.

providers.name: cansinotech
providers.description: CanSino Biologics (康希诺生物, cansinotech.com.cn / cansinotech.com) is a Tianjin-based Chinese biopharmaceutical company founded in 2009 and dual-listed on the Hong Kong and Shanghai (STAR) exchanges. It researches, manufactures, and commercializes human vaccines across five proprietary technology platforms, with a portfolio covering COVID-19, meningococcal, pneumococcal, tuberculosis, Ebola, and DTcP indications. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or technical documentation; only its corporate web presence was found.

providers.name: Centreherbs (Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology)
providers.description: Centreherbs is the brand of Beijing Shengtaier Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a veterinary pharmaceutical company founded in 1999 and headquartered in the Daxing Biopharmaceutical Industrial Park, Beijing, China. An integrated research, development, production, and distribution organization for animal health, it specializes in veterinary traditional Chinese medicine preparations, animal vaccines for poultry and livestock, plant-based premixed feed additives, and pet health products, backed by four wholly-owned subsidiaries and an internal biotech research institute. It is a healthcare portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a corporate marketing website and publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: cmlabs
providers.description: CMLabs (千麦医疗 / Qianmai Medical) is an independent third-party clinical laboratory group headquartered in China. It operates a network of medical testing laboratories that provide clinical laboratory diagnostics, pathology diagnosis, routine and specialty blood testing, clinical trial and research testing, and laboratory information system (LIS) services to hospitals, clinics, and other medical institutions. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface.

providers.name: dezhentech
providers.description: Dezhen Technology (德臻) is a Shanghai-based healthcare information technology company providing informatization solutions for public hospitals and medical institutions across China. Its portfolio spans hospital operations management centers, integrated electronic medical record (EMR) systems, information integration platforms, hospital data centers and big-data analytics, refined operations management dashboards, EMR interoperability testing, and domestic (localized) technology transformation of core hospital systems. Dezhen is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this profile the company publishes a corporate marketing site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API specifications.

providers.name: dkmedtech
providers.description: dkmedtech (Suzhou Dingke Medical Technology Co., Ltd.) is a medical device manufacturer founded in 2010 in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, developing interventional vascular devices across three areas: peripheral vascular intervention, cardiovascular intervention, and neurovascular intervention. With a team of 100+ and a global manufacturing center launched in December 2025, its products carry NMPA (China), CE (Europe), and FDA (United States) regulatory clearances. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, the company was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub; it publishes a corporate website but no developer API, documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: firstgrid
providers.description: The domain firstgrid.cn resolves to Shanghai Shouige Network Technology Co., Ltd. (上海首格网络科技有限公司 / "Shouige Network"), a Chinese software and logistics-services provider focused on the medical-device industry. Its products include the Medical Jiecloud Platform (医捷云), a bidirectional logistics intelligence and supply-chain management system, a public database platform, and third-party warehousing/distribution services for medical-device producers, distributors, and 3PLs, with offices in Shanghai and an R&D center in Hangzhou. The company was surfaced as a portfolio lead of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As of this enrichment pass the public site is a Chinese-language corporate marketing site and exposes no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface, so no API artifacts could be harvested. Note: the recorded English name "firstgrid" is the pinyin of 首格 (Shǒugé) and the domain/company identity should be verified against the intended qiming portfolio company.

providers.name: guahao
providers.description: guahao.com is the flagship consumer domain of WeDoctor (微医), the Chinese digital-health platform that began as Guahao.com (挂号网) — literally the "appointment-registration network" — connecting patients to hospitals and physicians for online appointment booking, telemedicine consultations, e-prescriptions, and chronic-disease management. Founded in Hangzhou around 2010 and among the early investments of Qiming Venture Partners, the company operates a large internet-hospital and clinic network across China. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced from a venture-portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the public site sits behind a bot-challenge WAF (Tencent EdgeOne infrastructure), so no public developer/API surface was discoverable in this pass — the captured artifact is a live domain-security probe.

providers.name: guokang
providers.description: Guokang (国康私人医生 / Guokang Private Doctor, 深圳市国康健康管理服务有限公司) is a Shenzhen-based corporate and personal health-management service provider founded in 2005. It positions itself as one of China's leading health-management companies, integrating more than 1,000 domestic and international medical resources — private physicians, specialist experts, tertiary hospitals, and health-examination centers — to deliver private doctor services, family medical-care programs, and corporate health services such as medical screening, employee assistance programs (EAP), group insurance, and on-site corporate health centers. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture network; no public developer portal or API surface was found during enrichment (the site is served behind a Huawei Cloud WAF).

providers.name: huimei
providers.description: Huimei Technology (惠每科技) is a Chinese medical artificial intelligence company whose core hospital-facing platform, Dr.Mayson, delivers clinical decision support systems (CDSS) built on a curated medical knowledge base. Its product suite spans specialty CDSS, single-disease quality management and reporting, medical-record quality control, DRG/DIP insurance cost control, and VTE intelligent prevention, helping hospitals raise clinical quality and safety. Huimei is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. This profile was surfaced through the VC portfolio graph and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company publishes no public developer API program at this time.

providers.name: innostic
providers.description: Innostic is a China-based medical-device distribution and healthcare supply-chain company, established in 2015 and originally profiled as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Its public web presence at www.innostic.com now resolves to the Shanghai Jianfa Zhixin Medical Technology group, which operates across medical-device distribution, in-vitro diagnostics (IVD), hospital supply-chain management (SPD and centralized distribution), and consumer healthcare supply-chain services for manufacturers, distributors, and hospitals. The company is a B2B healthcare logistics and distribution firm; its only online systems are internal, login-gated operational platforms (Zhixin, U9, OA). As of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDK, MCP server, or /.well-known discovery surface. This profile records verified company identity and a domain-security probe; there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: jfkbio
providers.description: jfkbio (今复康生物科技 / JFK Bio) is a biotechnology and life-sciences company in China, surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its public presence at jfkbio.com is a JavaScript single-page marketing site; no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI definition, or other machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment, so most API artifact types are not applicable to this provider. This profile records what is genuinely observable today (identity and live domain-security posture) and remains a lead pending any future developer or API surface.

providers.name: LIH Healthcare (长和医疗)
providers.description: Beijing Changhe International Medical Investment Management Co., Ltd. — operating as LIH Healthcare (长和医疗) — is a Chinese rehabilitation-medicine group that invests in, manages, and operates rehabilitation hospitals and outpatient clinics. The company imports international rehabilitation techniques, service models, and management practices and adapts them to the Chinese market across pediatric developmental and behavioral rehabilitation, cardiopulmonary and critical-care rehabilitation, pain rehabilitation, neurological rehabilitation, and bone and joint rehabilitation. Its three business models are building and investing in high-standard rehabilitation hospitals and clinics, co-operating rehabilitation-medicine departments inside existing general hospitals, and selling systematized rehabilitation service solutions (planning, clinical pathways, operations, equipment, IT consulting, and staff training) to hospitals. Facilities include Beijing Changhe Dayun Pediatric Clinic, Shanghai and Shenzhen pediatric rehabilitation outpatient centers, and Kunming Changhe Tiancheng Rehabilitation Hospital. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. LIH Healthcare publishes no public developer program, API, or SDK — this profile carries identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: longwill
providers.description: Longwill (Zhejiang Kangjiu Health Technology Group, 浙江康久康养科技集团有限公司) is a Chinese digital elderly-care and community-health group building what it calls a "China digital elder-care ecosystem" (数字康养). Operating from Xiaoshan District, Hangzhou, it runs 40-plus medical and senior-care institutions across Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Jiaxing, Ningbo, Quzhou, Jinhua, Zhoushan), Chengdu (Sichuan) and Shizuishan (Ningxia), organized around a "five-in-one" care model spanning a digital care cloud, CCRC senior-living complexes, institutional medical-and-elder care, community care and home care. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of this enrichment pass Longwill publishes a corporate marketing website (www.longwill.com.cn) but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: medmotion
providers.description: MedMotion (复动肌骨 / 复动医疗, Shanghai Fudong Medical Management Co.) is a China-based musculoskeletal medical company founded in 2018 in Shanghai, building an integrated orthopedic, rehabilitation, orthotics, and physical-conditioning care model for conservative treatment and pre-/post-surgical recovery of sports and skeletal injuries. It operates three product lines: offline musculoskeletal rehabilitation medical centers, the PhysioCloud cloud service platform, and the NMPA-approved TELEREHAB (悦行) musculoskeletal digital-therapeutics device. It is backed by Qiming Venture Partners (Pre-A lead), TF Capital, and SunMed Capital. As of this enrichment pass MedMotion publishes a patient/clinic-facing marketing site and app backend but no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or developer portal, so no API artifacts were harvested.

providers.name: MedSci
providers.description: MedSci (梅斯医学 / MedSci Healthcare Holdings Limited, HKEX 2415) is a leading online professional physician platform in China, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Shanghai. It connects roughly 2.9 million registered physician users with pharmaceutical and medical device companies through big data and AI, offering physician platform solutions (medical knowledge, clinical study assistance), precision omni-channel marketing, real-world study (RWS) solutions, and the MedSci xAI medical AI agent. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. No public third-party developer API program, OpenAPI/SDK, or developer portal was found; the primary web host is geo-restricted and unreachable for HTTP probing.

providers.name: My China Roots
providers.description: My China Roots is a Chinese heritage genealogy platform that helps people of Chinese descent trace their ancestry, find records of their ancestors, connect with long-lost relatives, and organize roots trips to China. The platform offers a searchable database of roughly 200 million ancestors drawn from digitized clan books (zupu), overseas immigration records, tombstones, obituaries, and clan association member lists, alongside family-tree building and a Library Edition for institutions. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; the company exposes a consumer web application only, with no discoverable public API, developer portal, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Prime Life Science
providers.description: Prime Life Science (璞睿生命科技) is a Chinese life-science technology company focused on digital and intelligent (数智化) clinical research. Its business spans the full lifecycle from clinical research to commercial decision-making, offering digital innovation solutions built on big data and artificial intelligence. The company positions itself as a "digital intelligent clinical research accelerator" aimed at driving innovative drug and device development, health management, and improved clinical-research decision-making and operational efficiency in China. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming venture fund and added to the API Evangelist network; the public presence is a WordPress marketing site with no developer or API surface discovered during enrichment.

providers.name: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care
providers.description: Sai De Yang Guang Oral Care (赛德阳光口腔) is a dental healthcare chain operating across China, founded in 2007 by orthodontist Zhou Yanheng, formerly a director at Peking University School of Stomatology. It runs roughly 30 clinics across major cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, Xiamen, Xi'an, Tianjin, Shenyang and Changsha, with nearly 340 treatment chairs, and provides orthodontics (including Invisalign), dental implants, pediatric dentistry, cosmetic dentistry and periodontal treatment. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company operates a patient-facing website (appointment booking, clinic locations, expert profiles) and publishes no public API or developer program.

providers.name: sh-eco
providers.description: SH-ECO (翊科聚合物 / Yike Polymer) is a Chinese medical-device materials manufacturer specializing in the research, production, and customized fabrication of medical catheters and membrane materials. Its product range spans single-lumen tubing, multi-lumen tubing, composite/multi-layer tubing, and injection-molded components serving healthcare and multiple industrial applications. The company is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. It publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: shsongli
providers.description: shsongli (Shanghai Pine & Power / Songli Biotech Co., Ltd.) is a Shanghai-based biotechnology and medical-device maker specializing in the R&D, manufacture and sale of biological hemostatic products, most notably animal-derived quick-dissolving fibrin glue with independent IP, used in surgery and expanding into tissue engineering. The company operates a Class III medical-device line and is ISO 13485 and GMP certified. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. The enrichment pass found no public developer or API surface: the shsongli.com domain returns 404 on every path (EIMS web server) with an expired TLS certificate, and no docs, portal, packages, MCP, llms.txt, /.well-known/ endpoints, or security program were published.

providers.name: shukun
providers.description: Shukun Technology (数坤科技) is a Beijing-based, globally operating AI medical-imaging company founded in 2017. It builds an AI-powered "Digital Doctor" portfolio (CoronaryDoc, NeuroDoc and related Digital Heart / Digital Brain products) that analyzes CT and other medical images to assist clinicians in screening, diagnosing, and planning treatment for cardiovascular, cerebrovascular, chest, abdominal and musculoskeletal disease. Shukun holds NMPA Class III certificates, EU MDR CE markings, and US FDA clearance across several therapeutic areas, and its products are deployed in nearly 3,000 healthcare institutions. The company is a clinical/enterprise AI vendor with no public developer or API surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Simple Love Yogurt
providers.description: Simple Love (简爱酸奶) is a Chinese natural yogurt brand operated by Pucheng Dairy (Group) Co., Ltd. (朴诚乳业), founded in 2016. Known for zero-additive, low-temperature fresh yogurts with short ingredient lists — including its no-sugar, probiotic, high-protein, and coconut lines — the brand is distributed across supermarket shelves in every Chinese province and operates its own manufacturing capacity in Hebei. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Hongshan and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As a consumer packaged-goods (CPG) dairy company it publishes a corporate/consumer website but no public developer, API, or programmatic surface.

providers.name: SinoMDT
providers.description: Sino Medical-Device Technology Co., Ltd. (SinoMDT), founded in 2007 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, is a high-tech medical equipment manufacturer that researches, designs, and produces accurate injection and infusion devices along with radiographic imaging diagnosis systems. Its product line spans the SN-50 series syringe pumps, SN-1500 series infusion pumps, SinoPower high-pressure contrast injectors used for CT/MRI/DSA enhanced scans, and molybdenum-anode film and full-digital mammography systems for breast radiographic diagnosis. SinoMDT is a portfolio company backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It manufactures physical medical hardware and publishes no public API, SDK, or developer platform.

providers.name: Sinotau
providers.description: Sinotau (先通医药) is a Chinese pharmaceutical innovator specializing in the research, development, production, clinical application, and academic promotion of radiopharmaceuticals (nuclear medicine). Formally established in 2014, the company focuses on three therapeutic areas — oncology, neurology, and cardiology — and has brought its first innovative product, 欧韦宁 (Florbetaben Fluorine-18 injection for PET brain imaging), to market alongside a pipeline of 10+ products in development. Sinotau operates multiple R&D and production facilities, employs 400+ staff, and holds 80+ authorized patents. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As a corporate radiopharmaceutical manufacturer, Sinotau publishes a corporate marketing website but no public developer platform, API, or technical documentation surface at this time.

providers.name: SinoUnited Health
providers.description: SinoUnited Health (曜影医疗) is a premium private healthcare provider headquartered in Shanghai, China, operating a group of international-standard medical and dental clinics offering family medicine, specialty care, and dental services. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As a private, in-person healthcare services provider, it publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal surface at this time.

providers.name: snssurgical
providers.description: snssurgical is a surgical / medical-device company (domain snssurgical.com.cn, based in China) surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. As of this enrichment pass the company website presents no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (its host serves a self-signed localhost certificate and redirects to a non-responsive HTTP endpoint), so there is no API to profile yet. This profile is a lead retained for future re-enrichment should an API surface appear.

providers.name: tisenc
providers.description: tisenc (天深医疗 / Tianshen Medical) is a Chinese in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) medical-device manufacturer based in Guangdong, backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The company develops chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzers and point-of-care testing (POCT) systems — its ACCRE 8, ACCRE 90, and ACCRE 120 single-sample chemiluminescence platforms and an accompanying reagent menu — together with a digital POCT management platform. It is a nationally recognized high-tech enterprise. tisenc operates a corporate marketing website only (WordPress/Qifeiye, hosted in China); as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDK, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: VINNO
providers.description: VINNO Corporation (飞依诺科技股份有限公司) is a Chinese medical device manufacturer, headquartered in Suzhou, that develops and produces digital color ultrasound (Doppler) imaging systems — cart-based, portable, and handheld/pocket devices — for clinical diagnostics and research. Product lines include the ULTIMUS and VINNO R-series ultrasound platforms plus Stream-series CPAP respiratory devices, built on proprietary soft beamforming and ultra-high-resolution micro-vascular imaging technology, with remote-diagnostic center and support services across 50+ countries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. As of enrichment the company publishes no public API, SDK, or developer surface (medical-device hardware manufacturer).

providers.name: xiaoniaokuaiyan
providers.description: Xiaoniaokuaiyan (小鸟快验) is an in-home health-checkup and blood-testing service brand operated by Beijing Cloud Artery Health Management Co., Ltd (北京云动脉健康管理有限公司), a Qiming-backed internet-healthcare startup based in Chaoyang, Beijing. It offers on-demand at-home sample collection by licensed nurses with results processed by nationally accredited laboratories, spanning routine checkups, tumor screening, infection testing, chronic-disease monitoring, and custom corporate and family panels. The company operates via its consumer website, WeChat official account, and mobile apps; it publishes no public developer portal, documentation, or API surface. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio lead and enriched by the pipeline; the honest result is that no public API artifacts exist to harvest.

providers.name: zeenhealth
providers.description: zeenhealth is a health company surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Its public web and API surface (zeenhealth.com, zeenhealth.cn, api.zeenhealth.com) is hosted on Chinese cloud infrastructure (Tencent Cloud, with Feishu/Lark email) and was not reachable from the enrichment environment, so no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation could be harvested this pass. This profile remains a lead awaiting a reachable developer surface.

providers.name: zhaohu365
providers.description: zhaohu365 (福寿康 / Fushou Kang) is a professional home-based elderly-care brand in China providing in-home nursing, rehabilitation, and long-term care services for aging populations through a network of community care stations and home-care teams. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. As a consumer healthcare-services provider, it does not currently publish a public developer program, API, or documentation surface; this profile carries the identity and domain-security posture captured by the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: 2duche
providers.description: 2Duche was a Chinese used-car marketing and trading service platform, backed by Qiming Venture Partners and recognized on the Red Herring Asia 100 in 2009. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass the company appears defunct — the apex domain 2duche.com does not resolve and www.2duche.com is unreachable, with no discoverable developer portal, API, documentation, SDKs, or public code repositories. No API artifacts could be produced without fabrication.

providers.name: 61draw
providers.description: 61draw (广东省六一线上非学科培训学校有限公司, Guangdong Liuyi Online Non-Academic Training School Co., Ltd.) is a China-based online children's art and non-academic education platform delivering live-broadcast art lessons to children roughly aged five to nine. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and Matrix Partners China, which co-led its Series B round, and was surfaced to the API Evangelist network as a venture-portfolio lead. The company runs a consumer web and mobile presence at 61draw.com; no public developer, API, or documentation surface has been found during enrichment.

providers.name: 7k7k
providers.description: 7k7k (7k7k.com) is a Chinese online casual gaming portal operating a consumer-facing website that aggregates hundreds of free browser-based mini games across action, role-playing, strategy, puzzle, and two-player categories. Surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. The 7k7k property is a consumer web destination and publishes no public developer platform, API, SDK, or developer documentation; enrichment probes confirmed no OpenAPI, no .well-known discovery documents, and no security-disclosure or trust-center program at this time.

providers.name: afujingyou
providers.description: afujingyou (阿芙 / AFU) is a Chinese consumer essential-oil, aromatherapy and skincare brand founded in 2006, backed by Qiming Venture Partners (Series C, 2017). It sells single and blended essential oils, base/carrier oils, masks, emulsions and face creams through retail and e-commerce channels (Tmall/JD/Weibo storefronts). Enrichment finding (2026-07-17): this is a consumer packaged-goods brand, not an API provider — no public developer portal, documentation, OpenAPI, or other API artifacts exist to harvest, and the catalog domain afujingyou.net.cn does not resolve (NXDOMAIN). Retained as an identity-only record; no API artifacts are applicable.

providers.name: AInnovation
providers.description: AInnovation (创新奇智, Qingdao AInnovation Technology Group) is a Chinese enterprise artificial-intelligence company founded in 2018 and listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (02121.HK). It focuses on "AI + Manufacturing", delivering industrial AI through its AInnoGC platform — an industrial large-language-model and AI-agent application-development platform — and its MMOC technology stack: ManuVision machine-vision, MatrixVision edge-video intelligence, and the Orion distributed machine-learning platform. It serves manufacturing verticals including semiconductors, steel, 3C electronics, automotive, energy, food and materials, construction, and financial services. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, the company reports 1,400+ patent applications. No public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: airquality
providers.description: AirQuality (爱优特) is a Shanghai-based manufacturer of high-efficiency electrostatic air purification and disinfection products, including central air filtration systems, commercial kitchen exhaust (hood) cleaners, odor-elimination units, and smart air-quality detection systems for schools, hospitals, offices, shopping malls, and hotels. The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. It is a hardware/manufacturing business that publishes a consumer website and online shop but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time, so most enrichment artifacts are not applicable.

providers.name: Alibaba Local Services
providers.description: Alibaba Local Services (阿里巴巴本地生活) is Alibaba Group's on-demand local-life services business, formed in 2018 by integrating the Ele.me food-delivery platform with the Koubei local-services and restaurant-discovery platform. It operates on-demand food and grocery delivery, local merchant services, reviews and reservations, and last-mile logistics across China, and received a major financing round led by the SoftBank Vision Fund. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the network as a lead; no distinct public developer API surface has been confirmed for the holding entity under this name (its consumer platforms Ele.me and Koubei operate their own separate open platforms).

providers.name: aplum
providers.description: aplum (branded Plum, Chinese 红布林) is a Beijing-based online marketplace for second-hand and pre-owned luxury fashion, founded in 2017. It runs C2B2C and B2B2C models — authenticating, grading, photographing, and reselling used designer apparel, handbags, watches, and accessories through its mobile app and website. Plum raised a $100M Series C from Zhuanzhuan Group in 2022, and earlier venture rounds from Qiming Venture Partners and Matrix Partners China. The platform is consumer-facing (Android app com.aplum.androidapp and mobile web m.aplum.com); it publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or developer portal, so it is catalogued here as a company profile rather than an API provider.

providers.name: appconomy
providers.description: Appconomy was a mobile-commerce platform company, founded in 2010 and dual-headquartered in Austin, Texas and Shanghai, China, that let brands, retailers, service providers, and mobile carriers add commerce functionality (daily deals, coupons, loyalty and rewards, mobile gifting, and merchant app generation for marketplaces such as Taobao) to their mobile apps. It was venture-backed with strategic investors including Qiming Venture Partners (lead of a $10M Series A), True Ventures, Neusoft Holdings, and WTI. The company is now permanently closed and publishes no live developer surface. The appconomy.cn domain does not resolve, appconomy.com returns 404, and no public API, documentation, developer portal, SDK, or /.well-known/ endpoint could be found. This profile is retained as a historical portfolio-graph record rather than an active API provider.

providers.name: Babycare
providers.description: Babycare is a Chinese mother-and-baby (母婴) consumer brand offering a broad range of maternity and infant-care products, including diapers, wipes, strollers, baby carriers, feeding bottles, toys, and maternal care goods. It operates primarily as a direct-to-consumer brand, selling through major Chinese e-commerce marketplaces (Tmall, JD.com, Douyin) alongside its own channels and offline retail, and is one of the leading new-generation mother-baby brands in China. Babycare is backed by venture investor Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). This profile is a consumer-brand entry in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been identified for this provider.

providers.name: Baicai
providers.description: Baicai (白菜二手车, "Baicai Used Cars") is a Chinese used-vehicle trading platform operating a new-retail model that pairs online used-car marketplaces with offline chain "used-car supermarket" stores. Vehicles listed on the platform are inspected by third-party agencies (100+ point checks that exclude major accident, water-damaged, and fire-damaged cars) and carry a return guarantee plus a warranty on major components. The business was spun out of and operates under 58.com (via Tianjin 58 Cloud Car / 天津五八云车) and became independently operated in 2021. It received early seed backing from Ribbit Capital. Baicai is a consumer-facing marketplace and does not publish a public developer platform, API, SDKs, or API documentation; this profile captures its identity and public web presence for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: BAMA TEA
providers.description: BAMA TEA (八马茶业), a brand of Fujian Bama Tea Industry Co., Ltd., is a large-scale Chinese tea enterprise founded in 1997 and headquartered in Anxi County, Quanzhou, Fujian Province. It integrates tea plantation cultivation, production and processing, branded retail-chain distribution, and export, and is best known for Tieguanyin oolong. The company operates a nationwide network of branded retail stores across China and sells oolong, black, green, white, and dark teas. It is a publicly listed company and a portfolio investment of IDG Capital. Added to the API Evangelist network as a consumer-sector lead: BAMA TEA publishes a consumer e-commerce website but no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface, so the API-artifact enrichment recipes do not apply.

providers.name: baoyugame
providers.description: baoyugame (Guangzhou Baoyou Network Technology) is a Chinese game development and publishing studio founded in 2011 and headquartered in Guangzhou, focused on the research and development of mobile games and web (browser) games. Its founding team came from established studios including NetEase, and it operates multiple internal game studios with a development team of roughly 100 people, shipping turn-based RPG, ARPG, and strategy titles. The company is venture-backed, appearing in the portfolios of Qiming Venture Partners, Morningside Venture Capital, and Jiuhe Capital. baoyugame publishes a consumer game website only and exposes no public developer API, documentation, or SDK surface, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: beijingyuanxin
providers.description: beijingyuanxin (Beijing Yuanxin) is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its primary domain beijingyuanxin.com is served over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) and 301-redirects to www.yuanxinjituan.com (Yuanxin Group). During this enrichment pass no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI/GraphQL) was discoverable; the domain answered TLS/DNS security probes, but its content host was not reachable from the probe location. This remains a portfolio lead pending a discoverable API surface.

providers.name: Belle International
providers.description: Belle International Holdings (百丽国际) is one of China's largest women's footwear and fashion retailers, designing, manufacturing, and distributing shoe brands such as Belle, Teenmix, Tata, and Staccato alongside a sportswear-distribution business, across thousands of directly operated retail outlets and a growing e-commerce presence. Formerly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, the group was taken private in 2017 by a consortium led by Hillhouse Capital and CDH Investments in one of the largest Hong Kong take-private deals. It was surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Hillhouse; enrichment found no public developer portal, API program, or machine-readable API surface for this consumer-retail company. This remains an identity and domain-security profile rather than an integratable API provider.

providers.name: black-unique
providers.description: Black Unique (全球购骑士特权, "Global Shopping Knight Privilege") is a membership-based consumer e-commerce and discounts platform founded in 2018 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China. Its core product is a privileges/membership card that aggregates discounts and special offers across a wide range of consumer categories: online shopping on major marketplaces such as Tmall, JD.com and Kaola, in-person shopping at international duty-free shops, outlets and supermarkets across 24-plus countries, plus dining, entertainment, travel and fuel. The company operates a consumer-facing app and website rather than a public developer program, and is backed by Qiming Venture Partners along with CCV, Eastern Bell Venture Capital and INCE Capital. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio lead; enrichment found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or other developer surface.

providers.name: bomming
providers.description: Zhuhai Boming Vision Technology Co., Ltd. (珠海博明视觉科技有限公司) is a Chinese high-tech industrial machine-vision company founded in September 2016 and headquartered in the Zhuhai High-tech Zone.
