It develops optical and machine-vision inspection technology for manufacturing quality control, including 3D structured-light sensors, flash measuring instruments (闪测仪), 2D/3D profile measurement systems, PCB back-drill thickness gauges, surface-defect inspection systems, glue-dispensing systems, and an AI deep-learning algorithm platform for automated visual inspection. Its solutions serve the lithium-battery, magnetic-materials, 3C electronics, semiconductor, photovoltaic, metalworking, and pharmaceutical industries. This is a hardware/equipment manufacturer with no public developer or API surface; the profile is retained as a VC-portfolio company lead.

providers.name: BrandCT
providers.description: BrandCT (品牌CT) is an offline-retail market-monitoring service operated by Mashangying (马上赢市场调查 / yikuaigao), a Chinese retail-data company. It has built a national offline-retail monitoring network based on POS data from a panel of sample stores, and delivers brand owners a "BrandCT" service that scans more than 10 million products across offline retail formats to quantify market share, distribution (铺市率), and product sell-through. The platform supports quantitative analysis of product innovation, channel competition, and category trends to speed up and sharpen client decision-making. The product is delivered through a login-gated web dashboard (WeChat, phone, and email verification sign-in); no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, or /.well-known discovery surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: cashbus
providers.description: CashBus (现金巴士), operated by Micro-Credit Speed Express (Group) Co., Ltd. (微额速达集团有限公司) of Shanghai, is a Chinese mobile financial-technology platform providing quick microloans to underserved consumers who lack access to traditional banking. The company runs an automated, AI-driven credit decision engine that scores applicants in seconds using thousands of risk factors and big-data analysis, with risk management spanning pre-loan, in-loan, and post-loan stages. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. The public presence is a corporate marketing site (company vision, team, careers, contact) with no published developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: cehome
providers.description: cehome (铁甲工程机械网, "Tiejia") is a Chinese digital platform for the construction and engineering machinery industry, operated at cehome.com and m.cehome.com. It is a professional information hub and community serving equipment owners, operators, dealers, and manufacturers: industry news and price data, product reviews, buying guides and detailed product listings across brands (Sany, Caterpillar, Komatsu, Doosan, and others) and equipment types (excavators, loaders, bulldozers, cranes), a used-machinery marketplace, operator job listings, and the active 铁甲论坛 community forum. cehome is a consumer/community web platform rather than an API provider; it publishes no public developer portal, OpenAPI, or programmatic API surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: changeducation
providers.description: ChangEducation is an integrated teaching-service provider of artificial-intelligence and STEAM curriculum systems, surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It builds AI and STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, Mathematics) curriculum products and teaching services for the Chinese K-12 education market. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes only a marketing website (changeducation.cn, which redirects to a JavaScript-rendered landing page) with no public developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI, SDKs, or documentation surface, so this profile remains an identity-only lead with no technical API artifacts.

providers.name: chatail
providers.description: Chatail is a Shanghai-based SaaS company (founded 2016) that provides private-domain livestream and video sales software for high-end and luxury retail brands across fashion, jewelry, beauty, automotive, and home-goods verticals, pairing intelligent customer acquisition with conversion tooling ("智能获客与高效转化双轮驱动"). The product is delivered as a hosted web application at chatail.com; no public developer API, documentation portal, or OpenAPI surface is published at this time (api.chatail.com serves a default nginx placeholder). Chatail raised a Series B round led by Qiming Venture Partners and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a Qiming portfolio company.

providers.name: Chery
providers.description: Chery Automobile Co., Ltd. is a Chinese state-owned automobile manufacturer headquartered in Wuhu, Anhui, and one of China's largest passenger-vehicle exporters, conducting business in more than 130 countries and regions. Its brand portfolio spans the core Chery marque (TIGGO and ARRIZO SUV and sedan series), the Fengyun and OMODA/JAECOO new-energy lines, and the QQ city-car brand, with a growing emphasis on the CSH (Chery Super Hybrid) powertrain and connected-vehicle technology. Chery was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. As an automotive manufacturer, Chery publishes corporate and consumer web properties but no public developer portal or API surface was found during this pass.

providers.name: chushou
providers.description: Chushou (触手TV / 触手直播) was a China-based mobile game live-streaming platform, at one point among the largest mobile-focused game streaming services in China, letting players broadcast and watch mobile gameplay. It was backed by Qiming Venture Partners and Tencent and is surfaced here as a portfolio lead. As of this enrichment pass the company's public web presence at chushou.tv is unreachable (the server returns empty replies) and it exposes no documented developer API, SDK, or portal, so this profile remains an inactive/defunct lead with no live API surface to enrich beyond DNS/TLS-level signals.

providers.name: coohua
providers.description: Coohua (酷划在线) is a Beijing-based Chinese mobile advertising company founded in 2014 and backed by Qiming Venture Partners. It pioneered the incentive- and lock-screen-advertising model in China, rewarding users with cash for unlocking their screens, reading content, and engaging with ads. Its flagship products include Coohua Lockscreen (酷划锁屏) and the Tao News (淘新闻) reading-rewards app, serving advertisers across internet, finance, automotive, and e-commerce verticals. At its peak Coohua captured a majority share of China's lock-screen advertising market and returned billions of yuan in cash rewards to users annually. providers.name: Dangdang
providers.description: Dangdang (当当, dangdang.com) is a Chinese business-to-consumer e-commerce company founded in 1999 and headquartered in Beijing. It began as one of China's largest online booksellers and expanded into a broad general-merchandise marketplace spanning books, e-books and e-readers, digital reading, consumer electronics, apparel, home goods, and maternal and baby products. Once listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ticker DANG) before being taken private, Dangdang was surfaced as a portfolio company of DCM Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. No active public developer program, open platform, or machine-readable API surface was reachable during enrichment (the site is geo-restricted); this profile carries a probed domain-security posture and awaits any discoverable API artifacts.

providers.name: DeepWay 深向
providers.description: DeepWay (深向科技 / Shenxiang Technology) is a Chinese intelligent new-energy heavy-truck company, backed by Baidu and Qiming Venture Partners, that designs and manufactures electric autonomous freight trucks it calls RoboTrucks. Its vehicle line includes the Xingchen II (深向星辰 II) and Xingtu (深向星途) electric heavy trucks paired with the Tianji (天玑) driver-assistance and autonomous driving stack, an AI-based fleet management platform, and a vehicle-owner mobile app. DeepWay reports 7,500+ activated L2 vehicles, a 30%+ subscription rate, and 300M+ km of assisted-driving operation, and follows a roadmap from L2 assistance (2023) to L4 platooning (2025) to single-vehicle L4 autonomy (2028). Its business model progresses from vehicle sales to subscription services to large-scale autonomous logistics capacity. As of this enrichment pass DeepWay publishes no public developer API, SDK, documentation portal, or machine-readable specification — this profile captures company identity and a domain-security probe only.

providers.name: Dingdong
providers.description: Dingdong (Dingdong Maicai / 叮咚买菜) is a Shanghai-based on-demand fresh-grocery e-commerce company operating a front-warehouse (dark-store) model that delivers fruit, vegetables, meat, seafood and prepared foods to consumers, typically within about 30 minutes, through its mobile app. The company is publicly listed on the New York Stock Exchange (ticker DDL) and is backed by Hongshan (formerly Sequoia Capital China). Its public surface (ddxq.mobi) is a consumer mobile-app backend rather than a developer platform; no public developer portal, API documentation, or open API program was found during enrichment, and the host is not reachable outside of China.

providers.name: Dingdong Maicai

It runs a mobile-app marketplace for fresh produce, meat, seafood, prepared foods, and daily groceries, backed by a network of front-line neighborhood micro-fulfillment stations that enable fast, same-hour delivery in major Chinese cities. The company is publicly listed on the NYSE (ticker DDL) and was backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. It is a consumer-facing operation with no public developer program or open API surface; this profile is a network lead maintained by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: DMall
providers.description: DMall (多点数智, Dmall Inc.) is an Asia-Pacific retail digitalization service provider that pairs consulting with technology to deliver an all-in-one digital retail operating system for supermarkets, grocery chains, and other retailers. Its cloud-native SaaS platform (Dmall OS) spans supply chain, point-of-sale, store operations, membership, e-commerce, and O2O fulfillment, helping traditional retailers modernize into data-driven omnichannel businesses. The company is backed by IDG Capital among other investors. DMall does not currently publish a public developer portal, open-platform documentation, or machine-readable API specifications; this profile captures its public web identity and domain security posture while awaiting a documented API surface.

providers.name: dstzc
providers.description: dstzc (地上铁, DiShangTie Green Technology, Shenzhen) is a leading Chinese provider of digitalized operations-management solutions for new-energy (electric) logistics vehicles. It operates a full-lifecycle fleet platform covering vehicle sales and leasing, digital fleet management, safety and risk management, maintenance, charging and battery-swap services, and residual-value management, reporting 224,000+ operational vehicles across 3,246 service locations spanning all 333 prefecture-level regions of mainland China. It is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company has no public API or developer surface; this profile is maintained as a company lead in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Eigentech
providers.description: Eigentech (eigentech.ai) is an artificial intelligence technology company, reported to have been founded around 2016 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, that applies AI and machine learning to business and industrial domains. Its platform is positioned to help enterprises improve operational efficiency, optimize workflows, and strengthen data-driven decision-making by embedding AI into existing business processes. Eigentech is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and was added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for the enrichment pipeline. providers.name: FangTek
providers.description: FangTek (Shanghai Fangtek Electronics Co., Ltd.) is a Chinese fabless semiconductor company headquartered in Shanghai. It designs highly integrated analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits for mobile phones, portable devices and consumer electronics, with a product line spanning audio power amplifiers, voice and audio processing, image processing, LED drivers, power management ICs, analog switches and DC boost converters. Qiming Venture Partners lists FangTek in its portfolio as "a leading provider of highly integrated circuit solutions for cell phone, portable device, voice processing, audio processing and image processing." FangTek is a silicon component vendor that reaches customers through electronics distributors; it publishes no public developer platform, web API, SDK or machine-readable API surface, so this profile carries identity and domain-security data only.

providers.name: fanli
providers.description: fanli (返利网, fanli.com) is a Chinese cashback and shopping-rewards platform that aggregates promotions, coupons, and rebate offers across major online retailers, letting consumers earn money back on purchases they route through the site. providers.description: Fenxiang Life (分享生活) is a Hangzhou-based Chinese social e-commerce and shopping-guide platform that combines cashback rebates with AI-driven price comparison. It returns platform commissions to consumers as cashback and analyzes historical price trends across major Chinese marketplaces including Taobao, JD.com, Pinduoduo, Douyin, and VipShop to help shoppers save money. providers.name: Full Truck Alliance
providers.description: Full Truck Alliance Co. Ltd. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or open platform on its corporate site; this profile carries verified company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Futurtec
providers.description: Futurtec (鑫君特) is a Chinese medical-device company founded in 2015 and recognized as a national high-tech enterprise, focused on orthopedic surgical robotics. Its flagship ORTHBOT surgical system combines navigation with automatic robotic execution — intelligent needle placement, non-invasive positioning, dual-camera navigation, and visual force-feedback pressure protection — and holds Chinese regulatory approval (Feb 2021) and EU MDR CE certification (May 2023). The company reports 251+ patents filed or granted, including 84+ invention patents and 25+ PCT applications. As of this enrichment pass, Futurtec publishes no public API, SDK, developer portal, or software surface: it is a clinical hardware manufacturer, so the enrichment pipeline found no API artifacts to harvest.

The company listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (SEHK: 1364) in February 2025, raising about US$233 million. It is a consumer-sector portfolio company of HongShan and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company profile. providers.description: Haoyiku (好衣库) is a Chinese private-domain social e-commerce and brand flash-sale platform operated by Haoyiku (Hangzhou) Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and associated with Jingling Group, founded in December 2017. providers.description: Huixiaoer (会小二) is a Chinese online platform for booking meeting venues, hotel conference rooms, and event spaces, operated by Beijing Yundong Digital Media Technology (北京云动数字媒体技术有限公司). It connects companies with a network of conference hotels and specialty venues across China and 20+ overseas cities, offering venue matching, price negotiation, and one-on-one meeting-planning advisors, plus bundled catering, accommodation, transportation, staging, team-building, incentive travel, and exhibition booth services on a free-to-client, commission-based model. providers.name: Luckypai
providers.description: Luckypai (乐酷天 / LuckyPai Ltd) was a Chinese television home-shopping company founded around 2006-2007 that grew into a leading nationwide TV and online shopping network, selling home appliances, cosmetics, apparel, food, and digital devices. It raised roughly $25M from investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Intel Capital, and the LOTTE Group, and was acquired by Lotte Home Shopping in 2010 for approximately $160M. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of lightspeed-venture-partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub. As an acquired, no-longer-operating consumer commerce business it has no public developer program, API, or independent web presence; the luckypai.com domain is parked and listed for sale.

providers.name: Mafengwo
providers.description: Mafengwo (马蜂窝, "Honeycomb") is a Chinese travel social and user-generated-content platform offering travel guides, destination reviews, trip notes (游记), community Q&A, and online booking for flights, hotels, tours, and local activities. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. No public developer or open-platform (开放平台) API surface was discoverable during this enrichment pass; the site is protected by anti-bot measures and exposes no OpenAPI, well-known discovery documents, or security.txt.

providers.name: Maimai
providers.description: Maimai (脉脉) is a Chinese professional networking and workplace social platform operated by Beijing Taoyou Tianxia Technology Development Co., Ltd. It combines professional networking, recruitment and talent matching, job referrals, company reviews and workplace community, and career-development learning (脉课堂) for the Chinese-language market. Surfaced as a portfolio company of dcm-ventures and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass Maimai publishes no public developer program, open platform, or API documentation, so this profile carries identity and domain-security signals only.

providers.name: mobike
providers.description: Mobike (Chinese 摩拜单车 / 摩拜科技, "Mobike Technology") was a Beijing-based dockless bicycle-sharing company founded in 2015. Riders located, unlocked, and paid for GPS smart-lock bikes through a mobile app and QR codes. Mobike was acquired by Meituan in 2018 and its standalone brand was subsequently folded into Meituan Bike; the public site (www.mobike.com) is now a bare ICP-filing landing page with no developer API, SDK, documentation, or portal surface. It is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: mogujie
providers.description: Mogujie (蘑菇街), operated by Mogu Inc. (NYSE MOGU), is a Chinese online fashion and lifestyle social-commerce destination that pairs a shopping marketplace with live video streaming and influencer-led content across apparel, beauty, and accessories. The company was formed from the 2016 merger of Mogujie and Meilishuo, is headquartered in Hangzhou, China, and listed on the New York Stock Exchange in December 2018. Mogujie's historical third-party open platform (open.mogujie.com) has been retired and now redirects away, and no active public API developer surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: MoreTickets
providers.description: MoreTickets (摩天轮票务), operated by Shanghai Juqitech, is a next-generation internet performance ticketing marketplace founded in 2015. The platform lets consumers buy and sell tickets to concerts, stage plays, musicals, and sports events through a transparent, competitive pricing marketplace with standardized ticketing services. It operates primarily as a consumer-facing web and mobile marketplace and does not publish a public developer API or open platform. The company is backed by Qiming Venture Partners and has raised a reported $108M in funding.

providers.name: nasn-auto
providers.description: NASN Automotive Electronics Co., Ltd. is a Shanghai-based automotive chassis electronic-control manufacturer founded in 2016, developing brake-by-wire and steer-by-wire systems for smart and assisted driving. Its products include the NBooster intelligent braking system, brushless electric power steering (EPS) controllers, and motion-control solutions for autonomous vehicles. Backed by Qiming Venture Partners, Matrix Partners China, Hillhouse and CATL, NASN has raised roughly $231M and is a Tier-1 supplier pursuing a Hong Kong listing. Surfaced as a Qiming portfolio company; NASN is an automotive hardware manufacturer with no public developer API surface at nasn-auto.com.

providers.name: nvxclouds
providers.description: nvxclouds is the web home of 锘崴科技 / NVX, whose legal entity is Hangzhou Nuowei Information Technology Co., Ltd. (杭州锘崴信息科技有限公司), an information technology company based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. It was surfaced through the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming. The public website at nvxclouds.com is a single-page web application served over TLS from Alibaba Cloud infrastructure. An enrichment pass on 2026-07-20 probed the domain and common developer paths and found no public API, developer portal, OpenAPI or documentation surface to catalog; this profile records the verified corporate identity and domain-security posture and remains a lead pending any future developer-facing API surface.

providers.name: OneASP
providers.description: OneASP (Application Security Protection) is the runtime application security product line of OneAPM (Beijing Blue Ocean Xuntong Technology / 蓝海讯通), a Qiming-backed Chinese IT operations management (ITOM) and application performance monitoring vendor founded in 2008. OneASP delivered runtime application self-protection (RASP) for web applications, and was also marketed internationally under the OneRASP brand. As of enrichment (2026-07), no standalone OneASP developer portal, public API, or SDK surface resolves - the oneasp.com brand domain no longer resolves and OneASP appears to be a legacy/absorbed product line of the parent OneAPM platform.

providers.name: PPS (pps.tv)
providers.description: PPS (pps.tv), originally the PPStream peer-to-peer online-video client, is a Chinese internet-video brand backed by Qiming Venture Partners. The pps.tv domain now issues a permanent HTTP 301 redirect to suike.cn, the home of iQIYI Suike (爱奇艺随刻) — a video-sharing and short-video community operated by iQIYI. It is a consumer video product; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or /.well-known discovery surface, so there is no API artifact set to harvest for this profile.

providers.name: prmeasure
providers.description: prmeasure (Precision Measurement & Control, 精实测控) is a Zhuhai, China based high-tech enterprise specializing in measurement, control, and artificial intelligence technologies for flexible manufacturing. The company builds industrial-grade testing and control equipment for the consumer electronics, automotive, and home-appliance industries, and offers consumer-level customized production through a C2M (customer-to-manufacturer) model. Its WowNow platform (iwownow.com) provides creative prototyping tools and flexible manufacturing equipment for individuals. prmeasure was surfaced as a portfolio company of the Qiming Venture Partners investment graph and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes a corporate marketing website only, with no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Qunar Com
providers.description: Qunar (去哪儿网, "where to go") is a Chinese online travel platform founded in 2005 and headquartered in Beijing. It operates a travel search and booking service covering domestic and international flight tickets, hotel reservations, train and bus tickets, vacation packages, and travel deals. Qunar was NASDAQ-listed (QUNR) and is majority owned by Trip.com Group (formerly Ctrip). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Mayfield and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; no public developer portal or API program was discoverable at open.qunar.com, developer.qunar.com, or api.qunar.com during this enrichment pass.

providers.name: reetian
providers.description: reetian (Chinese brand 瑞天数智, Reetian Digital Intelligence) is a China-based digital-intelligence company surfaced as a portfolio company of the venture firm qiming and added to the API Evangelist network. Its public presence is a JavaScript single-page marketing site at reetian.com fronted by Cloudflare; as of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or source repositories that could be discovered and harvested. This profile remains a company-level lead pending a public API surface.

providers.name: Renren
providers.description: Renren (人人网), originally launched as Xiaonei in 2005 and renamed in 2009, was one of China's largest social networking platforms and was widely described as the "Facebook of China," especially popular among university students. Renren Inc. listed on the NYSE in 2011; the social-networking business later declined and the assets were sold in 2018. The site is now operated by Chengdu Renren Interactive Entertainment Technology Co., Ltd. and is undergoing a service upgrade. Historically Renren ran an Open Platform with an OAuth2 REST API (wiki.dev.renren.com) for third-party login and social integration; that developer surface is now defunct and no live API endpoints respond.

providers.name: roxmotor
providers.description: ROX Motor (roxmotor.com) is a Chinese electric-vehicle manufacturer, a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners, best known for the ROX 01 electric off-road SUV. It is a consumer automotive brand with no public developer API surface; this profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio lead and enriched with a domain-security probe. The site is hosted on Tencent Cloud and was not reachable from the enrichment environment for content search.

providers.name: ruhnn
providers.description: Ruhnn Holding Limited (如涵控股) is a Hangzhou-based Chinese influencer (KOL) incubation, marketing, and e-commerce company. It pioneered the "internet celebrity" (wanghong) commercialization model, signing and developing influencers and monetizing their audiences through self-operated online stores on marketplaces such as Taobao and Tmall, as well as through a platform/advertising business that connects its network of KOLs with third-party brands for social-marketing campaigns. The company listed on NASDAQ under the ticker RUHN in 2019 and was subsequently taken private. It is surfaced here as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Ruhnn is a consumer-facing influencer marketing and commerce operator and does not publish a public developer platform, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: sinocelltech
providers.description: Sinocelltech (Beijing Sino Cell Biotechnology Group Co., Ltd.; Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market code 688520) is a biopharmaceutical research and development company founded in 2002 by Dr. Xie Liangzhi. It develops and commercializes recombinant protein and monoclonal antibody therapeutics across oncology, autoimmune disease, and infectious disease, together with preventive vaccines including a recombinant 14-valent HPV vaccine and COVID-19 vaccines. The company has multiple marketed products in China and a pipeline of clinical-stage candidates. It publishes no public developer platform, API, or technical documentation surface.

providers.name: SPES (speschina)
providers.description: SPES (诗裴丝) is a China-based consumer personal-care and beauty brand operating a direct-to-consumer business across Chinese e-commerce and social-commerce channels, including its Tmall flagship store, a JD.com storefront, and Douyin, Xiaohongshu (RED), and Weibo social accounts, with a WeChat official account. The brand runs a marketing website (a Vue.js / Element UI single-page app served from Alibaba Cloud) and was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It does not currently publish any public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, developer portal, or API documentation; the only HTTP API referenced by its site is a private content backend for the marketing pages. This profile records the enrichment pass that confirmed there is no public API surface to catalog.

providers.name: Super Sports Media
providers.description: Super Sports Media Group is an IDG Capital-backed Chinese sports-media company best known for holding the English Premier League broadcast rights in mainland China and operating consumer sports streaming and content services under the ssports.com brand. Its platform was subsequently absorbed into iQiyi Sports (爱奇艺体育), and ssports.com now redirects there. This is a business-to-consumer sports streaming and media-rights operation with no public developer program: no API documentation, developer portal, SDKs, OpenAPI, or open platform surface could be found during enrichment. Profile retained as a network company record.

providers.name: t4game
providers.description: t4game (呈天游 / Bstonegames) is the brand of Beijing Chengtian Network Technology Co., Ltd., a Chinese online-game developer and operator founded in 2008 and headquartered in Beijing. The company designs, publishes, and operates mobile, PC, and web-based games — including titles such as 醉江湖online (Drunk Rivers and Lakes Online) and 诛神传奇/诛神online (Zhushen Online) — spanning role-playing, real-time strategy, and shooting genres. Its public presence at t4game.com is a consumer-facing game portal (player login, registration, and recharge), company and culture pages, a product catalog, game/media news, and recruitment listings. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of the venture firm Qiming. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program: no developer portal, API reference, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specification, SDKs, CLI, MCP server, or other machine-readable API surface could be found.

providers.name: thorough
providers.description: thorough (透彻未来 / Thorough Future) is a China-based company surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. Its site at thorough.ai serves a Chinese-language single-page web application over HTTP only (HTTPS is unreachable at the time of this pass) and exposes no public API, developer portal, documentation, or machine-readable specification surface. This profile remains a lead awaiting a public developer surface.

providers.name: Three Squirrels
providers.description: Three Squirrels (三只松鼠) is a Chinese consumer snack company founded in 2012 by Zhang Liaoyuan and headquartered in Wuhu, Anhui Province. Positioned as one of China's first internet-native food brands, it sells nuts, seeds, dried fruits, baked goods, and other leisure snacks primarily through e-commerce channels (Tmall, JD.com, and its own storefronts) alongside a growing offline retail footprint. The company is publicly listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange ChiNext board (stock code 300783). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment; as a consumer packaged-goods retailer it does not publish a public developer API, open platform, or API documentation. Sector: consumer.

providers.name: Tiebaobei
providers.description: Tiebaobei (铁甲二手机) is a used construction-machinery C2C trading platform operated by Beijing Tiejialong Technology Co., Ltd. (北京铁甲龙科技有限公司). Founded in 2009 out of the Tiebaobei (Cehome) construction-equipment forum, it lets individuals buy and sell used excavators, loaders, bulldozers, cranes, rotary drills and other heavy equipment, backed by a network of ~400 regional "city manager" brokers across 30 Chinese provinces who verify and co-inspect machines. The platform layers industry news, equipment inspection/detection, price rankings and financing services on top of the marketplace. It raised A financing from Qiming Venture Partners, a DCM-led Series B (¥100M, 2015) and a Yuansheng-led Series C (¥200M, 2016). This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public developer API or open platform was found.

providers.name: To Summer
providers.description: To Summer (观夏 / Guanxia) is a Chinese premium home-fragrance and lifestyle brand founded in Beijing, known for its Eastern-inspired scented candles, incense, diffusers, perfumes, and bath and body products. Positioned as a direct-to-consumer scent brand, it sells primarily through its own website, WeChat mini-program, Tmall flagship store, and a growing footprint of physical concept stores across China. To Summer is backed by IDG Capital and was surfaced through the API Evangelist venture-portfolio pipeline. As a consumer retail brand it exposes a customer-facing e-commerce experience rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its identity and the outcome of an enrichment probe that found no public API surface.

providers.name: tuhu
providers.description: Tuhu (途虎养车) is a Chinese online-to-offline automotive services platform founded in 2011 and headquartered in Shanghai. Through its app, website, and network of franchised and self-operated workshops it sells tires and provides car maintenance, repair, and related aftermarket services to consumers across China. Tuhu is publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (9690) and counts Qiming Venture Partners among its investors. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company; enrichment probes found no public developer API, open platform, or developer portal.

providers.name: Tujia
providers.description: Tujia (途家) is a Chinese online marketplace for short-term rentals, vacation homes, and homestays, frequently described as "China's Airbnb." Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Beijing, the company connects travelers with apartments, villas, and serviced homes across China and select international destinations through its website, mobile apps, and WeChat mini-program. Tujia runs a consumer-facing booking marketplace and property-management services rather than a public developer platform. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network; the enrichment pipeline probed the domain and found no public API, developer portal, or open platform for the company.

providers.name: VIPThink
providers.description: VIPThink (豌豆思维) is a Chinese online education company operated by Guangdong Happy Seeds Technology Co., Ltd. (广东快乐种子科技有限公司), delivering small-class live-streaming courses in mathematical thinking and logic for young children (roughly ages 3-8). It is part of a family of consumer education brands that also includes Hualala drawing classes (画啦啦), Wandou speech training (豌豆口才), Gubi early-learning (咕比启蒙), and Little Lighthouse (小灯塔). The company was surfaced as a portfolio company of SoftBank Vision Fund and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, VIPThink operates only consumer-facing web and mobile learning products and publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs, or machine-readable API surface.

providers.name: Wandoujia
providers.description: Wandoujia (豌豆荚, "pea pod") is a Chinese Android app distribution platform and mobile assistant launched in 2009 by Beijing-based Wandoulabs (Zhuoyi Xunchang Technology). It was known for its PC-based Android management client and its in-app content search that indexed apps, games, video, and other content across the Chinese Android ecosystem. Wandoujia was acquired by Alibaba/UCWeb in 2016 and folded into Alibaba's app-distribution business. Its consumer and developer web properties (www., open., and developer.wandoujia.com) no longer resolve; only residual Alibaba-hosted infrastructure (api. and account.wandoujia.com) remains, and there is no documented public API surface.

providers.name: Yunji
providers.description: Yunji (云集) is a leading membership-based social e-commerce platform in China, founded in Hangzhou in May 2015. Yunji curates a wide range of consumer products across health food, beauty, personal care, digital devices, and apparel, and uses a member-driven model in which members earn rewards by sharing products with their social contacts. The company applies big data and artificial intelligence to optimize the shopping experience and incentivize social promotion. Yunji listed on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange (ticker YJ) in May 2019 as the first membership-based Chinese e-commerce firm to do so. Yunji was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. As of this enrichment pass, Yunji operates as a consumer mobile-app commerce platform and publishes no public developer or open API program.

providers.name: Ziroom
providers.description: Ziroom (自如) is a Beijing-based proptech company operating China's largest centralized long-term apartment rental platform. Spun out of the Lianjia (Homelink) real-estate group in 2011, it leases, renovates, furnishes and manages residential units and re-rents them to urban tenants through its app and website, layering on cleaning, maintenance and smart-home services. It is backed by the SoftBank Vision Fund, Tencent and Sequoia Capital. This profile was added to the API Evangelist network as a VC-portfolio lead; enrichment found no publicly discoverable developer or API surface.

providers.name: Zuoyebang
providers.description: Zuoyebang (作业帮) is a Chinese educational technology company founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing, backed by SoftBank Vision Fund. It operates a "technology + education" online learning platform whose flagship homework-help app lets K-12 students photograph a problem to get step-by-step answers, on-demand tutoring, and self-study tools across all subjects, alongside math tutoring products aimed at elementary-school parents and teachers. It is a consumer mobile/web product with no public developer program, open platform, or documented API surface at the time of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Bestcomm
providers.description: Bestcomm (Bestcomm Pharmaceutical) is a China-based pharmaceutical company backed by IDG Capital, surfaced as a portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment. It operates in the healthcare / life-sciences sector and raised venture funding alongside IDG Capital and regional investors. As a pharmaceutical manufacturer it has no known public developer portal, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or programmatic API surface; this profile remains a company lead rather than an API provider. It is distinct from the unrelated BestComm Networks wireless-LAN company.

providers.name: cdhot (Hot New Energy Technology)
providers.description: cdhot (Hot New Energy Technology) is a Chinese industrial energy-efficiency company listed in the Qiming Venture Partners portfolio. Qiming describes the company as providing EPC (engineering, procurement and construction) and EMC (energy management contracting) services to industrial customers to achieve waste heat recovery — capturing surplus process heat from industrial operations and converting it into reusable energy. The company is an engineering and energy-services business rather than a software or API provider. As of the July 2026 enrichment pass its published website at cdhot.cc did not resolve over HTTPS, redirected to www.cdhot.cc over HTTP and returned an empty HTTP 404, and no developer portal, documentation, specification, or API surface of any kind could be found.

providers.name: coremed
providers.description: CoreMed (Beijing) Biomedical Research Co., Ltd. is a China-based contract research organization (CRO) founded in 2013 that provides clinical professional services for innovative cardiovascular medical devices and structural-heart products. Its services span animal testing, human clinical trials, data management, statistical analysis, and independent core-laboratory imaging analysis, and it was among the first domestic providers in China to run trials for interventional heart valves, LAA occluders, and bioresorbable scaffolds. Headquartered in Beijing with branches in Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Chengdu, CoreMed is backed by Qiming Venture Partners. This is a services/CRO company with no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable surface; its site (coremed.com.cn) was unreachable at enrichment time (connection refused, expired TLS cert).

providers.name: gammastar
providers.description: GammaStar (GammaStar Medical Group) is a Shanghai-based medical-device company backed by Qiming Venture Partners that develops, manufactures, and services precision radiotherapy and oncotherapy equipment, including rotary cobalt-60 gamma-ray radiosurgery systems, and operates a network of oncotherapy and psychosurgery centers. It is a medical-hardware manufacturer rather than an API provider; enrichment found no public developer portal, API documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, or MCP surface, and the gammastar.com domain currently resolves to a parked "for sale" listing on Atom.com rather than a corporate site.

providers.name: gaugene
providers.description: Gaugene (Beijing Zhizhen Biotechnology Co., Ltd. / 知真生物), founded in 2017 and headquartered in Beijing, China, develops and supplies flow cytometry instruments and reagents for the in-vitro diagnostics and life-sciences research market. Its analyzers use high-power lasers and high-sensitivity multi-color fluorescence detection for clinical hematology diagnosis, single-cell analysis, protein screening, and clinical-indicator discovery. Gaugene is a venture-backed diagnostics-hardware and reagents maker rather than an API provider; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no reachable public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface (its apex domain does not resolve and www.gaugene.com returns a 502). It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub via Qiming Venture Partners.

providers.name: i-Incubator Healthcare
providers.description: i-Incubator Healthcare is a pharmaceutical innovation incubator established by IDG Capital and officially launched in Shanghai (Xuhui District) in 2024. It operates an "incubation + empowerment" model to develop innovative drug-research programs across oncology, immunology, and metabolic disease areas, pairing global innovation perspectives with China-based execution to advance projects to international quality standards. It is backed by a dedicated, long-horizon (15-year) incubation fund. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital; this is a research/biotech venture with no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: immune-path
providers.description: Immune-Path (Yidao Biotechnology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. / 怡道生物) is a China-based vaccine biotechnology company founded in 2017 and headquartered in Suzhou. The company develops human vaccines across recombinant protein antigen, novel viral vector, and messenger RNA (mRNA) platforms, backed by its own vaccine adjuvant technology. Its clinical and preclinical pipeline includes a recombinant zoster (shingles) vaccine produced in CHO cells, a nine-valent recombinant HPV vaccine expressed in Pichia pastoris, a respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccine, a therapeutic gastric cancer vaccine, and a COVID-19 vaccine. Immune-Path is a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. It is a life-sciences drug developer with no public developer, API, or software surface; this profile is maintained as a company record in the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: inbilin
providers.description: inbilin was a Shanghai-based social networking mobile app founded in 2013 that let users place voice calls to strangers, either dialing a person of interest or being paired at random for a live conversation. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead. Public company databases (Crunchbase, CB Insights, Tracxn) record inbilin as permanently closed / deadpooled; the inbilin.com domain no longer resolves to a live site and no developer program, documentation, OpenAPI, SDK, or public API surface could be located during enrichment.

providers.name: justmedical
providers.description: JUST Medical Devices (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. (嘉思特医疗器材（天津）股份有限公司) is a Chinese orthopedic medical device manufacturer based in Tianjin, China, and a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. The company designs and produces joint replacement implants and orthopedic prosthetics, applying 3D printing and additive manufacturing to hip, knee, and other joint reconstruction systems. Its public presence at justmedical.cn is a corporate marketing website (built on the Faisco/fkw.com site builder); the company publishes no developer program, API, SDK, or machine-readable API surface. This profile is retained as a company identity record in the API Evangelist network rather than an API provider entry.

providers.name: Kanghui Medical
providers.description: Kanghui Medical (Changzhou Kanghui Medical Innovation Co., Ltd.), founded in 1997 and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province, China, is an orthopedic medical device manufacturer focused on the R&D and production of trauma and spine implants and instruments, plus professional surgical education and services across China and emerging markets. Formerly China Kanghui Holdings (NYSE: KH), it was acquired by Medtronic in 2012 and now operates as a Medtronic company. This is a corporate/physical-device provider with a public marketing website but no public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface; the profile is maintained as an API Evangelist network company record.

providers.name: Kelun-Biotech
providers.description: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. (Kelun Botai, HKEX: 6990), a Chengdu-based subsidiary of Sichuan Kelun Pharmaceutical (SZSE: 002422) established in 2016, is an innovative biopharmaceutical company focused on the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of novel drugs. It specializes in antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) and other conjugated therapies across both large-molecule and small-molecule modalities, targeting oncology and autoimmune diseases. The company operates several core drug-discovery platforms and maintains a pipeline of 30+ candidates with multiple approved and clinical-stage programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network; as a pharmaceutical manufacturer it publishes no public developer or API surface.

providers.name: Marvel Tech (Mufan Power)
providers.description: Marvel Tech (Mufan Power, 慕帆动力) is a Chinese industrial power-equipment manufacturer developing next-generation zero-carbon clean power-generation technology and products. Its portfolio centers on hydrogen-fuelled gas turbine generating sets, high-speed multi-stage cantilever turbines, special-gas and TRT flow-path (通流) turbines, dry low-NOx combustors, and industrial waste-heat and waste-pressure recovery equipment. The company runs a corporate brochure website in Chinese and English (ICP 沪ICP备17001438号) and publishes no public developer, API, or SDK surface. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Minghui Pharmaceutical
providers.description: Minghui Pharmaceutical is a company surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network as a stub for enrichment. Sector: healthcare. This profile is a lead awaiting the enrichment pipeline.

providers.name: Minova Pharma
providers.description: Nanjing Minova Pharmaceutical Technology Co., Ltd. (南京迈诺威医药科技有限公司) is a drug-discovery and pharmaceutical R&D company founded in February 2021 and headquartered in Nanjing, China. The company focuses on the discovery, development, and industrialization of novel drugs for mental diseases and disfiguring (cosmetic/dermatological) diseases, operating in the consumer-pharmaceutical space as both a drug R&D house and supplier. Its stated capabilities span early drug discovery, compound/drug screening, and druggability (developability) research. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network. Minova Pharma publishes a corporate marketing website but exposes no public developer portal, API, SDK, or machine-readable interface.

providers.name: Novast Laboratories
providers.description: Novast Laboratories is a pharmaceutical development and manufacturing company (CDMO) headquartered in Nantong, Jiangsu Province, China, founded in 2005 by Dr. Guohua Zhang and a multinational management team. Novast specializes in high-barrier, difficult-to-formulate generic and specialty pharmaceuticals, including ultra-low-dose hormonal and extended- / modified-release oral products built on proprietary drug-delivery technologies. It is noted as one of the first China-based pharmaceutical companies to gain U.S. FDA approval for finished drug products marketed in the United States, and provides contract development and manufacturing services to generic and innovator companies. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Novast is a physical pharmaceutical manufacturer and publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDK, or developer documentation surface.

providers.name: Ping An Good Doctor
providers.description: Ping An Good Doctor (Ping An Healthcare and Technology Company Limited, since rebranded Ping An Health, HKEX: 1833) is the online-healthcare arm of China's Ping An Insurance Group and one of the country's largest one-stop online healthcare platforms. Through its consumer app it offers online medical consultations delivered by an in-house medical team and AI triage, family-doctor memberships, a health mall for pharmaceutical and wellness e-commerce, and health-management and chronic-disease services. The platform serves individual consumers as well as enterprise and financial channels across China. As surfaced to the API Evangelist network it is a consumer/enterprise app business with no public developer API program: enrichment found no developer portal, OpenAPI, SDKs, or open-platform documentation, and the historical corporate domain (pahtg.com) now resolves to a parked landing page.

providers.name: Ping An HealthKonnect
providers.description: Ping An HealthKonnect (Ping An Healthcare Technology), founded in September 2016 and headquartered in Shanghai, is a technology-driven managed care platform in China. As an AI-powered big data platform it brings together patients with providers of health insurance and medical services, offering budget planning, precision healthcare, medical health-care accounts, medical resources management, health records, and fraud/abuse detection to optimize healthcare spending. The platform covers roughly 70% of Chinese cities and a market of some 800 million people, and has raised about USD 1.15 billion backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, IDG Capital, and others. It is a B2B and government-facing enterprise platform with no public developer API surface; this profile was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment.

providers.name: Rens Energy
providers.description: Rens Energy is a Shanghai-based distributed energy-storage and energy-management company founded in 2017. It builds distributed energy-storage systems and energy-management software that let customers deliver power and energy-balance scheduling, energy-usage analysis, and energy optimization for efficient operation and asset appreciation of their power assets. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Enrichment probing found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Shanghai Desano Pharmaceutical Group
providers.description: Shanghai Desano Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. is a Chinese pharmaceutical company established in 1996 and headquartered in Shanghai's Zhangjiang High-Tech Park. It develops and commercializes medications addressing global public health needs, specializing in anti-AIDS (antiretroviral) and anti-malaria drugs, steroid hormone drugs, and nucleic acid drugs, with operations spanning R&D, manufacturing, regulatory registration, and international distribution across multiple production bases in Shanghai, Jiangsu, and Jiangxi. Note: in this company's domain "API" means Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient (drug chemistry), not a web/developer API. Desano publishes no developer API, OpenAPI, SDK, developer portal, or other machine-readable API surface, so the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline has no technical artifacts to produce for this provider. It was surfaced as a false-positive lead from the Qiming venture portfolio.

providers.name: Shulan Health
providers.description: Shulan Health (树兰医疗 / Shulan Medical Management Group) is a Hangzhou-based private healthcare group founded in 2014 by academicians Li Lanjuan and Zheng Shusen. It integrates hospital services, life-science research, medical education, and incubation investment, owning and operating comprehensive medical institutions and providing hospital-management services to partner hospitals across China. Services include rehabilitation, nutrition, health examinations, regional medical imaging, and remote consultation. Its information systems are built internally by subsidiary Huazhuo Technology on a self-developed RubikStack hybrid-cloud platform; the group publishes no public developer portal or API. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network as an enrichment lead.

providers.name: Sunshine Lake Pharma
providers.description: Sunshine Lake Pharma (Guangdong East Sunshine Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., also known as HEC Pharm) is a Chinese pharmaceutical company established in 2003 and part of the Dongyangguang (HEC) Group. It engages in drug research, development, production, and commercialization across innovative drugs, improved formulations, generics, and biosimilars, focused on infections, chronic diseases, and oncology. Notable products include oseltamivir phosphate (influenza), sofosbuvir-based hepatitis C therapy, and insulin glargine (diabetes). It is a manufacturer with no public developer or API surface. Surfaced as a portfolio company of idg-capital and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Vincentage
providers.description: Vincentage (Vincentage Pharma Co., Ltd.) is a clinical-stage biotech founded in 2021 and headquartered in Suzhou, China, developing novel small-molecule drugs for metabolic and cardiometabolic diseases including type 2 diabetes, obesity, and MASH. Its lead candidate is VCT220 (also known as CX11), an oral small-molecule GLP-1 receptor agonist; worldwide rights (excluding Greater China) to CX11 were acquired by Corxel Pharmaceuticals. Investors include IDG Capital, Everest VC, Shenzhen Capital Group, Galaxy Industry Group, and Kunshan Asia Aroma. Surfaced as a portfolio company of IDG Capital and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; as a drug-discovery pharmaceutical company it publishes no public API, developer portal, or technical artifacts.

providers.name: Wecare Probiotics
providers.description: Wecare Probiotics (微康益生菌) is a Chinese biotechnology company specializing in probiotic strain research, intelligent manufacturing, and application solutions for the food, nutrition, and agriculture industries. It operates three research institutes and five intelligent manufacturing facilities across Suzhou, Luohe, and Wuhan, producing product lines including WecLac probiotics, WecPro formula, and WecCul. Its BLa80 strain became the first probiotic strain approved for infant food in mainland China. The company presents a corporate information website only; no public developer portal, API, or technical documentation is published, so this profile carries company identity rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Zhuhai DL Biotech (medicaldl)
providers.description: Zhuhai DL Biotech Co., Ltd. (Zhuhai Deer Bioengineering Co., Ltd., brand "DL" / 迪尔), founded in 2003 and based in Zhuhai, China, is a high-tech in-vitro diagnostics (IVD) enterprise specializing in the R&D, manufacturing, and service of microbial diagnostic instruments and reagents. Its product lines cover automated blood culture systems, automated bacterial identification and antimicrobial susceptibility testing (ID/AST), MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry microbial identification, automated staining, fluorescence immunoassay, and molecular diagnostics, serving over 5,000 clinical healthcare institutions across more than 50 countries. Surfaced as a portfolio company of Qiming Venture Partners. Enrichment pass found no public API, developer portal, SDK, or software integration surface — this is a diagnostic-hardware and reagent business, not a software/API provider.

providers.name: DCM Ventures
providers.description: DCM Ventures (formerly Doll Capital Management, and commonly known as DCM) is an early-stage venture capital firm founded in 1996 by Dixon Doll, a former Accel partner, and David Chao, and headquartered at 2420 Sand Hill Road in Menlo Park, California with additional offices in Beijing and Tokyo. DCM was among the first Silicon Valley firms to build a cross-border, US-Asia investing practice, and typically leads early-stage rounds with checks in the roughly $1M-$5M range, deploying capital into a small group of category-defining companies each year rather than investing broadly. The firm's thesis has evolved from its original focus on communications and semiconductors toward consumer internet and SaaS, and today centers on vertical SaaS, fintech, cross-border innovation, and AI-native applications across the United States, China, Japan, and Southeast Asia. As of 2025 DCM manages approximately $4.5 billion in assets and reports 400+ portfolio companies, 35+ unicorns, and over $150 billion in aggregate market value, with notable investments including SoFi, Bill.com, Kuaishou, Matterport, 51job, Careem, and Sansan.

providers.name: HongShan (HSG)
providers.description: HongShan (HSG), formerly known as Sequoia Capital China, is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing across technology, healthcare, and consumer sectors. Founded in 2005 by Neil Shen with early guidance from Sequoia Capital, the firm spun off as an independent entity in 2023-2024, rebranding from Sequoia China to HongShan (a pinyin romanization of its Chinese name, meaning "redwood") while retaining its original Chinese name. HSG invests across the full lifecycle - seed, venture, growth, buyout, and infrastructure - and also runs a public equities business (HCEP). The firm manages over USD 61 billion in assets (as of April 30, 2026) and has backed more than 1,700 companies since inception, with 180+ having gone public and 140+ reaching unicorn status. HSG operates from Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, London, Tokyo, and Singapore. Notable portfolio companies include Alibaba, ByteDance, Meituan, Pinduoduo, BYD, Nio, Xpeng, Airwallex, Canva, Monzo, and Moderna.

providers.name: IDG Capital
providers.description: IDG Capital is a global investment firm founded in Boston in 1993 and headquartered in Hong Kong, widely recognized as one of the first foreign venture investors to enter China. Over more than 30 years it has grown into a multi-stage platform spanning venture capital, growth capital, buyout, secondary markets, and public markets, with reported assets under management of roughly $20–23 billion. The firm has backed 1,800+ companies and realized 600+ exits, employing 300+ staff (about 40% investment professionals) across 12 offices on three continents, including Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Singapore, Seoul, Boston, New York, Barcelona, Muscat, and the Cayman Islands. IDG Capital concentrates on Consumer, Consumer Technology, Healthcare, and Fintech/Web3, and its portfolio includes early bets on many of China's technology leaders — Tencent, Baidu, Xiaomi, Meituan, ByteDance, and Ctrip — alongside global names such as Coinbase, Circle, Farfetch, Moncler, Acne Studios, and Insta360.

providers.name: Qiming Venture Partners
providers.description: Qiming Venture Partners is a leading China-based venture capital firm founded in 2006 by Duane Kuang and Gary Rieschel, headquartered in Shanghai with additional offices in Beijing, Suzhou, Hong Kong, Singapore, and a U.S. affiliate (Qiming Venture Partners USA) in Seattle, Washington. The firm invests at the early and growth stages, with roughly 70% of its investments concentrated in Series A and Series B rounds, across two core practice areas: Technology (mobile internet, consumer, AI, robotics, semiconductors, enterprise software, autonomous driving) and Healthcare (biotech, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health). Qiming manages 11 U.S. Dollar funds and 7 RMB funds with approximately $9.5 billion in capital raised, and has backed more than 580 companies, of which over 210 have exited via IPO on the NYSE, NASDAQ, HKEX, Shanghai, or Shenzhen exchanges, or through M&A. It is an early backer of some of China's most influential technology companies, including Xiaomi, Meituan, Bilibili, Zhihu, Roborock, Hesai Technology, UBTech, WeRide, Insta360, and Zhipu AI (Z.ai), alongside a deep healthcare portfolio spanning Zai Lab, Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals, CanSino Biologics, Tigermed, and Insilico Medicine.
